title: Credit repair customer service va
description:
Hoodrich Credit is a US credit repair and credit mentorship company. We're hiring one dependable, detail-focused person to be the first point of contact for our clients and to get every new client set up the same day they sign up.



This is not a sales job, and you won't send disputes (our dispute team does that). Your job is to make sure no client is ever left waiting and no file is ever stuck.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Onboard new clients: check their documents (photo ID, proof of address, credit monitoring login), build their profile in Credit Repair Cloud, move their card in GoHighLevel, and hand the file to our dispute team, all on the same day.

- Answer clients by text,
 and client-portal message the same business day, and end every shift with an empty inbox.

- Answer our business phone line live and return missed calls within the hour.

- Work client complaints posted in Slack: fix the problem, tell the client, and check it off the same day.

- When our dispute team finds new negative items on a client's credit report,
 and text the client to offer adding them to their disputes, send the payment link, and mark it paid in Slack.

- Fix credit monitoring login problems so the dispute team can pull reports.

- Give clients clear, accurate updates on where their file stands.

- Post a short end-of-day report in Slack.



WHAT YOU NEED

- Excellent spoken and written English. You'll be on the phone with US clients every day.

- 2+ years of customer service with US clients (phone,
 and chat).

- GoHighLevel and/or Credit Repair Cloud experience is a big plus. We'll train you on our process either way.

- Strong attention to detail. You'll handle IDs, Social Security cards and credit reports, so accuracy and confidentiality are a must.

- You follow a checklist every time and own a problem until it's fixed.

- Available Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM US Eastern. That's 10:30 PM to 7:00 AM Philippine time (9:30 PM to 6:00 AM from mid-March to early November). Weekends off.

- Fast, stable internet with a backup, a quiet place to work, and a headset with a good mic.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Full-time, long-term position

- Paid every two weeks

- Full training with written SOPs and video walkthroughs

- A clear daily checklist, so you always know what "done" looks like



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip these steps won't be reviewed)

1. Use this subject line: ONBOARDING VA - [Your Full Name]

2. Tell us about your customer service experience with US clients and the tools you've used.

3. A client texts: "I sent my documents a week ago and nobody has answered me. This is ridiculous." Write the exact reply you would send.

4. Send a 1 to 2 minute voice recording introducing yourself (Vocaroo, Loom or a Google Drive link).

5. Include your speedtest.net result link and your backup plan for power or internet outages.

6. Confirm you can work 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM US Eastern, Monday to Friday.

7. Tell us your expected monthly rate in USD.

title: Real Estate  Bookkeeping software devolper/bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper & Software Builder – Real Estate Portfolio (Houston, TX)



Tabora Properties is a family-owned real estate and property management company in the Houston area. We own and manage residential apartments, commercial rentals, and a self-storage facility across several LLCs. We are moving off QuickBooks completely and want a simple, custom bookkeeping system built for our properties, likely using AI tools. We're looking for someone who can build it and run the books.



What you'll do



Design and build a custom bookkeeping system for multiple LLCs and properties, using AI tools where they make sense (automatic transaction categorization, receipt reading, bank data imports)

Fully migrate all historical records out of QuickBooks so we can cancel it permanently

Maintain the books going forward: record rent payments, deposits, and property expenses by property

Reconcile bank and credit card accounts monthly

Track security deposits, vendor bills, and recurring expenses like utilities, insurance, and property taxes

Organize records and work with our CPA at tax time



What we're looking for



Real estate or property management bookkeeping experience is a plus

Experience building software or automations (spreadsheets, databases, web apps, or AI tools like ChatGPT/Claude APIs)

QuickBooks experience, specifically for exporting and migrating data out of it cleanly

Detail-oriented, organized, and reliable

Knowledge of basic U.S. real estate tax rules (depreciation, Schedule E, 1099s for vendors, deductible expenses) is a major plus

title: Best Shopify Developer/Designer (CRO / Landing Pages / AB Testing) (Full-Time)
description:
ABOUT US

We are a US-based e-commerce company operating a growing portfolio of subscription brands, launching 2 new brands every month. Our brands are organized into pods — small teams that each own up to 10 brands. This role joins a pod team.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Own conversion rate across a pod of 10 max Shopify subscription brands.

- Improve all store content/copy from PDP, Homepage, FAQ, Contact, About, and all internal pages, check for wrong inconsistent information that needs to be updated.

- Build and improve landing pages, offers, and site experiences.

- Update all stores for any promotions (content, banners, promos) like seasonal, or like BFCM.

- Run a continuous testing program — one active A/B test per live brand.

- Execute page pivots when a brand's numbers call for a fix.

- Report to the Pod Manager; craft line to the Head of Ecommerce.

- Maintain and update stores promos, specials, and any kinds of requests.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR - PLEASE DON'T APPLY IF YOU DON'T HAVE CRO EXPERIENCE

- Shopify experience required (store build and theme customization)

- You have run real CRO tests and can explain what won, what lost, and why

- You think in funnel steps: traffic ? add-to-cart ? checkout ? purchase

- Data-first, self-directed, strong written English

- Good design Skills / Good eye for design



WHAT WE OFFER

- $700-1,100/month depending on experience

- Full-time, long-term role with a fast-growing company (we plan to be at 100+ brands)

- Clear playbooks and SOPs — you will always know what good looks like

- 13th month pay



HOW TO APPLY (Required):

1. Start your application with "Kanemitsu is Amazing!" so we know you read this far - This should be appended in the TITLE ONLY.

2. Answer in 5 sentences or less: a store gets 3% add-to-cart but only 0.8% purchase. Walk through your diagnosis: what do you look at, in what order?

3. Include your relevant experience.

4. Share a bit more about your hands-on experience with CRO and A/B testing - specifically, I'd like to hear about a real test you managed—what variant won, what lost, and what key takeaway or hypothesis drove those results.

5. READ THE WAGE/SALARY before you apply to avoid confusion.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a PAID test before any interview. The test is the interview.



Detail is very important. Applications with missing details will be ignored and again, please those with experience only and should be able to do it without assistance and be able to successfully optimize the assigned stores. If you don't hear from me, means you didn't follow instruction.



Stephen | Head of Ecommerce, C. Corp.

title: Medical Scribe (Chiropractic) — Remote VA (HIPAA-Trained, 30+ hrs/week)
description:
We are a busy U.S.-based chiropractic clinic providing spinal adjustments, rehabilitation exercises, posture correction therapy, and acupuncture.



We are looking for a detail-oriented virtual medical scribe to join our team on an ongoing basis. You will be trained directly on our clinical documentation workflow and will work closely with our team to ensure patient notes are accurate, complete, and audit-ready.



We value reliability, attention to detail, and clear communication. This is an ongoing position with the opportunity for continued work based on performance and clinic needs.



Role Overview



You will create clean, accurate, audit-ready SOAP notes in DrChrono based on the provider's patient encounters.



Daily Output

Approximately 25–50 patient notes/day

Notes must be completed daily and reviewed for accuracy



Working Hours (CST)

Monday: 8:45 AM–12:00 PM · 2:45 PM–6:00 PM

Tuesday: 2:45 PM–6:00 PM

Thursday: 8:45 AM–12:00 PM · 2:45 PM–6:00 PM

Friday: 8:45 AM–12:00 PM

Saturday: 7:45 AM–11:00 AM



Key Points



Saturday availability is mandatory

30+ hours/week availability required

Must be online and on-camera when patients are being seen

We use Time Doctor for time tracking

Notes must be completed daily and reviewed for accuracy



Requirements



Strong written English with clear clinical documentation skills

HIPAA certification or training

Saturday availability (non-negotiable)

Reliable computer and stable internet (20+ Mbps)

Quiet, professional workspace

High attention to detail

Prior medical VA, medical scribe, or healthcare administration experience preferred

EHR experience; DrChrono is a plus

Preferred

Chiropractic or physical therapy background

Familiarity with medical terminology (ROM, orthopedic tests, musculoskeletal findings)

Experience with structured clinical documentation

Experience working with U.S. healthcare providers

Compensation



$4–$6 per hour, depending on experience



30+ hours/week

Paid weekly via Wise (preferred)



What We Offer



Clear expectations and structured workflow

Ongoing work opportunity

Direct training and feedback

Opportunity to grow with the clinic based on performance and clinic needs



What We Value



Confidentiality — HIPAA compliance is critical.



Accountability — Own mistakes and report them promptly.



Reliability — Daily completion and consistent availability matter.



Attention to detail — Small documentation errors can have a big impact.



Honesty — If you are uncertain, ask rather than guess.



How to Apply — Strict Instructions



Applications missing any required item will not be reviewed.



1. Opening Line (Required)



“I read the full job post — chiropractic scribe”



2. Short Answer (2–3 sentences)



What does HIPAA mean to you in a remote work context?



3. Confirm

Are you comfortable with an ongoing position with a consistent weekly schedule? (Yes/No + brief note)

Are you available Saturdays 8:00 AM–12:00 PM CST? (Yes/No)

4. Attach



Resume — Please highlight healthcare, medical VA, or scribe experience.



1-minute video — Loom or unlisted YouTube.



Your video must include:



Your name + brief introduction

Relevant experience

Why this role interests you

One sentence about how you handle patient confidentiality

5. Include



Please provide:

EHR systems you have used

Internet speed

Relevant medical VA/scribe experience

Your experience with SOAP notes or clinical documentation

title: URGENT: CUSTOMER SERVICE SALES REPS NEEDED! HIRING TODAY!  (LA UNION)
description:
Are you a hungry professional who is GREAT on the phone?  We’re a people centric Sales Development Rep(SDR) team seeking professionals who like to serve customers and WANT TO GROW IN THEIR SALES SKILLS.

You’ll spend a lot of time making phone calls to customers and prospects to offer helpful healthcare products that help clinics get more patients and be more profitable. If that resonates with you, please keep reading.

Our dynamic CSR and SDR team is on the lookout for someone who’s ready to make a positive impact and earn what they deserve.

 

We only require a GOOD attitude, RESILIENT to make lots of phone calls and STRONG American conversational skills and PATIENT even if it requires some repetitive tasks.

What You’ll Do:

1 - Reach out to prospective customers through the phone.

2 - You’ll be given a script to follow to expedite your outreach process.

3 - You’ll be given all the info you need to help make successful phone calls.

4 - If they have questions, your manager will step in to help you right away.

5 - You’ll work US pacific time zones, Monday through Friday.

6 - You’ll get paid both a BASE + COMMISSION based on your results.

Our 3-Step Onboarding Process:

1 - You’ll first start on a short paid internship to test your skills

2 - You’ll move into a probation period to prove your skills

3 - You’ll transition to a full-time contract polishing your skills

What We’re Looking For:

A - High conversational skills: You want to sound like you live next door to a customer.

B - Passion for customer satisfaction: You genuinely enjoy helping customers and have a natural knack for delivering exceptional service.

C - Passion for seeing customers buy services from you. 

D - Good work ethic: You understand that we cannot teach attitude and discipline. You love to show up on time and contribute to success.

E - Cool under pressure: Angry clients don’t faze you – you know it's not personal and you are focused on ensuring they get what they need.

Availability:

1 - Monday through Friday, from 9 AM to 6 PM PH Time Zone.

2 - You’re not just looking for a job – you’re eager to grow with us and make a lot of commission based on your efforts.

3 - You’re hungry to become a professional - you’re kind, but resilient, never giving up to reach clients who need your help.

Why You’ll Love It Here:

1 - You’re honest: We and our customers are humans. You love people and always want to treat them right by telling the truth, both inside the company and with clients.

2 - You’re committed: We believe in nurturing talent from within, so your long-term aspirations are important to us.

3 - You’re professional: You’re committed to excellence and always show up on time and don't make excuses.

If you’re ready to bring your CSR and sales magic to our team and make a difference in the lives of our customers, we’d love to hear from you!

Click on the attached link below and we'll have application instructions for you there.

title: eCommerce Virtual Assistant
description:
Our remote team is growing, and we’re looking for a reliable, motivated and detail-focused eCommerce Virtual Assistant who wants to build a lasting career with us.



We’re an agency based in the Philippines, running the day-to-day operations of eCommerce brands for clients across the globe. This role is a great fit for someone who takes their work seriously, picks things up fast, owns their tasks, and wants to grow real skills in the online selling industry.



Fair warning: this is a busy role. Since we handle several client accounts at once, no two days look the same. Some days bring a long list of tasks, last-minute changes, tight turnarounds and priorities that shift quickly.



We need someone who stays organized, follows processes carefully, works well under pressure, and keeps the quality of their work high even when things get hectic.



If you’re proactive, dependable and comfortable working on your own, this could be the long-term opportunity you’ve been looking for.



Role Details



-Start date: As soon as possible

-Shift: Graveyard, Philippine time

-Work days: Monday to Friday

-Weekends: Off

-Type: Full-time, long-term



From time to time, you may need to work extra hours for urgent client requests, key deadlines or time-sensitive updates. This won’t happen every day, but being flexible matters in a fast-paced eCommerce setting.



What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll support the daily operations of several eCommerce brands. Your work may include:



-Running and maintaining Shopify, WooCommerce and Amazon stores

-Building, editing and optimizing product listings

-Researching products, competitors and market trends

-Helping with customer support and order handling

-Updating websites and handling general admin work

-Supporting marketing and content tasks

-Designing simple graphics and marketing visuals in Canva

-Making basic layout and design improvements to websites

-Using ChatGPT and other AI tools to work faster and more accurately

-Following our systems, SOPs, checklists and instructions

-Juggling tasks across multiple client accounts

-Replying quickly to task updates and requests during your shift

-Keeping work organized and on time during heavy periods



As you prove your reliability and build experience, you’ll take on more: handling client accounts more independently and working on bigger, higher-value projects.



What We’re Looking For



-A fast learner who can figure things out on their own

-Highly organized, with a sharp eye for detail

-Owns their work and is accountable for results

-Follows instructions precisely and hits deadlines

-Communicates clearly and professionally

-Hardworking, with a proactive mindset

-Thrives in a fast-moving environment

-Stays calm and professional with urgent requests

-Has their own reliable laptop or desktop

-Has a stable, fast internet connection

-Is fully available for the entire shift

-Has no other job, clients, business or personal commitments that could affect their availability, focus or performance



Bonus Skills (Not Required)



-Shopify experience

-Canva or basic graphic design skills

-A good eye for clean layouts and visual presentation

-Experience with ChatGPT or other AI tools

-Basic video editing in CapCut

-Background in virtual assistance, eCommerce, customer service or admin work



Experience isn’t everything.

We care more about discipline, attitude, consistency, honesty and reliability than years on a resume. We can teach the technical side, but the right mindset and commitment have to come from you on day one.



Pay and Growth



-Monthly salary: ₱25,000 to ₱30,000

-Monthly performance incentive: ₱5,000 to ₱8,000

-Regular salary increases based on performance

-A clear path to promotion and bigger responsibilities

-Room to grow into senior and leadership roles

-Long-term stability for consistent top performers



Why Join Us?



-Build a stable, long-term career with an established eCommerce agency

-Work with clear systems and processes

-Get proper guidance, training and regular performance feedback

-Gain hands-on skills in Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce and TikTok Shop

-Work with AI, automation and modern digital tools

-Get real experience with international eCommerce brands

-Develop skills that lead to senior and leadership positions



This Isn’t for Everyone

We’re not looking for someone who waits to be told what to do and does only the minimum.



We want someone who takes initiative, works smart, thinks critically, stays focused and owns the outcome.



The work can get intense, and priorities can change fast. You need to be comfortable adapting, handling several responsibilities at once, and keeping your quality high when things get busy.



Above all, we want someone who plans to grow with us for the long haul.



If you’re after a temporary gig, side income, an easy job, or something to do on top of another commitment, this probably isn’t the right fit.



How to Apply

Send us the following:



Your updated resume

-A screenshot of your internet speed test

-Your computer specs: device or model, processor, RAM and storage

-A short cover letter introducing yourself, sharing your relevant experience, and telling us why you’re the right person for this role



Important: Put “ECOMMERCE VA” in your
 subject line. Applications without it may be skipped, since it shows us you read the full post.



One Last Thing

This is a long-term role with real room to grow. We’re looking for someone ready to fully commit and become a reliable part of our team.



You must not have other jobs, clients or commitments that could get in the way of your schedule, availability, focus, productivity or performance.



If you’re disciplined, driven, eager to learn, and ready to build a serious career in eCommerce, we’d love to hear from you.

title: B2B Appointment Setter — US Roofing Companies (Manual Dialing, Work From Home)
description:

Get past gatekeepers and reach the owner

Pitch our service in a short conversation and book qualified sales calls on our calendar

Hit daily targets: 150+ dials and [5-10] booked calls per week

1+ year of B2B cold calling experience with US prospects (required)

Clear, natural English with a neutral accent

Comfortable handling objections and rejection without getting rattled

Reliable internet (25+ Mbps), a backup power source, and a quiet workspace

A noise-canceling headset

Experience with a CRM (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, or similar)

Available during US business hours



Bonus Points



You’ve set appointments for home services, contractors, or marketing agencies before

You’ve used a dialer like Kixie, JustCall, or Aircall



How to Apply (applications that skip these steps won’t be reviewed)



Start your application with the word “SHINGLE” in the subject line.

Attach a 1–2 minute voice recording of yourself calling a roofing company owner. Introduce yourself and ask for 15 minutes of their time.

Tell us your best month of booked appointments and what you were selling.

Confirm your availability during US hours.

title: CPA / Tax Preparer – Schedule C & TurboTax Expert
description:
CPA / Tax Preparer – Schedule C & TurboTax Expert



 About the Role



We are looking for an experienced U.S. tax professional, preferably a licensed CPA, who specializes in sole proprietorship and single-member LLC tax preparation. The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience using TurboTax to prepare and file individual tax returns with business income reported on Schedule C.



The tax professional will work closely with our bookkeeper to review financial records, ensure accurate expense categorization, identify legitimate tax deductions, and help maximize tax savings while maintaining full compliance with IRS regulations.



Key Responsibilities



- Prepare and file federal and applicable state individual income tax returns, including Schedule C (Profit or Loss From Business).

- Use TurboTax software to prepare and review tax returns accurately.

- Collaborate with our bookkeeper to review bookkeeping records, income, expenses, and year-end financial statements.

- Identify eligible business deductions, tax credits, and overlooked tax-saving opportunities.

- Review expenses such as home office costs, vehicle expenses, mileage, business travel, equipment, software, professional fees, and other applicable business expenses.

- Verify that deductions are properly documented, classified, and supported by applicable tax rules.

- Identify bookkeeping discrepancies, missing documentation, and potential tax reporting issues before filing.

- Advise on estimated tax payments, self-employment tax, and practical tax-planning strategies.

- Ensure compliance with current IRS requirements and applicable state tax laws.

- Provide recommendations to improve bookkeeping practices and tax efficiency for future years.



Required Qualifications



- Active CPA license preferred. Experienced Enrolled Agents (EAs) and qualified tax preparers with relevant experience may also apply.

- Demonstrated experience preparing U.S. individual tax returns with Schedule C business income.

- Strong, hands-on experience with TurboTax, preferably TurboTax Premium or the appropriate current product for Schedule C filings.

- In-depth knowledge of sole proprietorships, single-member LLCs, business expenses, and self-employment tax.

- Experience reviewing bookkeeping records and collaborating with a bookkeeper.

- Ability to identify legitimate deductions and explain tax-saving opportunities clearly.

- Strong attention to detail, professionalism, and confidentiality.



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience with small businesses and single-member LLCs.

- Knowledge of home office deductions, vehicle expense methods, depreciation, and business asset deductions.

- Experience with year-end tax planning and estimated tax payments.

- Ability to review existing bookkeeping records and recommend corrections before tax filing.



## How to Apply



Please provide the following information:



1. Your professional qualifications and CPA or EA credentials, if applicable.

2. Your experience preparing Schedule C tax returns.

3. Your level of experience with TurboTax and the specific version you use.

4. Your experience working with bookkeepers and identifying missed deductions.

5. Your fee structure and availability.



We are seeking a dependable, detail-oriented tax professional who can work collaboratively with our bookkeeper, thoroughly review our financial records, and help us identify all eligible tax deductions while ensuring accurate and compliant tax filings.

title: Remote Office Manager – U.S. Home Services Company (Industry Experience Required)
description:
About Our Company



Quality Air Duct Cleaning is a growing U.S.-based home services company operating in Houston and Austin, Texas. We specialize in air duct cleaning, HVAC system cleaning, mold remediation, and related residential and commercial services.



We are looking for a highly experienced, organized, confident, and responsible Remote Office Manager based in the Philippines who can take ownership of daily office operations.



THIS IS NOT A BASIC VIRTUAL ASSISTANT, CALL CENTER, OR ADMINISTRATIVE ASSISTANT POSITION.



We need someone who has actual experience running daily operations for a U.S.-based home services company, including answering calls, managing technicians, scheduling jobs, handling customer complaints, supervising employees, and ensuring the office operates efficiently.



We are looking for someone who can think independently, solve problems, make decisions, and take responsibility without requiring constant supervision.



Position Details



* Position: Remote Office Manager

* Location: Philippines – 100% Remote

* Starting Salary: $1,500 USD per month

* Schedule: Monday through Saturday

* Working Hours: 12 hours per day, 72 hours per week 7am to 7pm 

* Time Zone: U.S. Central Time (Houston, Texas)

* Employment: Full-Time, Long-Term Position

* Growth Opportunities: Opportunities for increased responsibility and compensation based on performance



Job Responsibilities



1. Customer Service & Incoming Calls



* Answer incoming customer calls professionally and confidently.

* Manage a high volume of phone calls throughout the day.

* Respond to customer questions regarding our services.

* Schedule new appointments and convert leads into booked jobs.

* Handle difficult customers, service complaints, and cancellations.

* Follow up with customers regarding pending estimates, appointments, and completed work.

* Maintain excellent customer service and professional communication.

* Ensure no customer inquiries or missed calls go unanswered.



2. Scheduling & Dispatching Technicians



* Manage daily scheduling for technicians operating throughout Houston and Austin, Texas.

* Schedule appointments based on technician location, driving distance, job requirements, availability, and performance.

* Understand geographical areas and use maps to optimize routes.

* Monitor technician schedules and job progress throughout the day.

* Coordinate multiple technicians and service appointments simultaneously.

* Handle last-minute scheduling changes, cancellations, and emergency requests.

* Communicate with technicians regarding job assignments, customer requests, and scheduling updates.

* Minimize unnecessary driving time while maximizing daily productivity.



3. Office Operations Management



* Take full responsibility for managing daily office operations.

* Ensure all calls, appointments, follow-ups, and administrative responsibilities are completed.

* Supervise and coordinate office staff and field technicians.

* Monitor daily workflow and identify operational problems before they affect customers.

* Develop and improve office procedures and employee performance.

* Make operational decisions independently when necessary.

* Maintain accurate customer records, job notes, and appointment information.

* Report operational performance, problems, and important updates directly to the owner.

* Ensure the business runs smoothly and efficiently without requiring constant supervision.



4. Employee Management & Recruiting



* Assist with recruiting, screening, and interviewing new employees.

* Coordinate employee onboarding and training.

* Monitor technician and office staff performance.

* Handle employee scheduling, attendance, and daily communication.

* Address employee issues, complaints, and performance concerns.

* Hold employees accountable for following company procedures.

* Coordinate technician assignments based on qualifications and productivity.



5. Sales, Estimates & Customer Follow-Up



* Follow up with customers who received estimates but have not booked.

* Help convert incoming leads into confirmed appointments.

* Communicate with customers regarding job pricing, scheduling, and service options.

* Track pending estimates and missed sales opportunities.

* Help improve booking conversion rates and customer retention.

* Coordinate with technicians regarding job updates, additional services, and customer requests.

* Identify opportunities to increase revenue and improve company performance.



6. CRM, Phone Systems & Reporting



* Manage customer information, appointments, and technician schedules using CRM software.

* Review call recordings and monitor incoming and missed calls.

* Track marketing lead sources and customer inquiries.

* Maintain accurate records of booked jobs, completed appointments, and pending estimates.

* Prepare operational reports and track employee performance.

* Help identify weaknesses in customer service, scheduling, and lead conversion.



REQUIRED Qualifications



Please read carefully. We are looking for experienced candidates only.



1. U.S. Home Services Industry Experience – REQUIRED



Candidates must have previous professional experience working for a U.S.-based home services company.



Relevant industries include:



* HVAC / Air Conditioning

* Air Duct Cleaning

* Mold Remediation

* Water Damage Restoration

* Plumbing

* Electrical Services

* Other residential or commercial field service companies



Candidates with direct experience in HVAC, air duct cleaning, or mold remediation will receive priority consideration.



General administrative, call center, or virtual assistant experience without home services industry experience is not sufficient.



2. Office Management Experience – REQUIRED



* Minimum 3 years of proven experience managing office operations or service business operations.

* Previous responsibility for scheduling or dispatching field technicians.

* Experience handling customer service, complaints, and daily operational problems.

* Ability to supervise employees and coordinate multiple departments.

* Proven ability to manage a busy office independently.

* Experience making operational decisions without constantly requesting management approval.



3. Excellent English Communication – REQUIRED



* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Clear, professional, easy-to-understand spoken English.

* Confidence speaking with American customers over the phone.

* Ability to explain services, manage complaints, and handle difficult conversations.

* Strong listening, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.



4. Scheduling & Dispatching Experience – REQUIRED



* Proven experience scheduling and dispatching field service technicians.

* Ability to organize multiple appointments and technicians simultaneously.

* Strong understanding of geographical scheduling and travel time.

* Experience using Google Maps or similar tools to plan efficient routes.

* Ability to adjust schedules quickly when problems occur.



5. Leadership & Independent Decision-Making – REQUIRED



* Strong leadership and management skills.

* Ability to take responsibility and ownership of daily operations.

* Excellent organization and multitasking skills.

* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment under pressure.

* Strong attention to detail and accountability.

* Proactive attitude toward solving problems.

* Ability to work independently without constant supervision.



6. Remote Work Requirements – REQUIRED



* Reliable computer capable of handling multiple applications.

* Fast and stable internet connection.

* Backup internet connection.

* Quiet, professional working environment without background noise.

* High-quality headset and microphone.

* Reliable availability during U.S. Central Time working hours.

* Ability to work the full Monday–Saturday schedule.



Preferred Software Experience



Previous experience with the following platforms is highly preferred:



Housecall Pro



* Customer management and CRM.

* Scheduling and dispatching technicians.

* Job management, estimates, and customer follow-ups.

* Tracking appointments and service history.



CallRail



* Call tracking and lead source management.

* Reviewing call recordings.

* Identifying missed calls and marketing performance.

* Monitoring call quality and conversion opportunities.



RingCentral



* Business phone system management.

* Answering and routing incoming calls.

* Managing call queues, voi
, and missed calls.

* Using call recordings and team communication features.



Experience with Workiz or similar field service management software is also valuable.



Candidates who already know Housecall Pro, CallRail, and RingCentral will receive priority consideration.



The Type of Person We Want



We want someone who takes ownership of the business operations and treats the company’s success seriously.



Someone who can:



* Run daily office operations without needing instructions for every task.

* Handle demanding customers professionally.

* Manage employees and technicians confidently.

* Recognize problems and solve them independently.

* Keep the schedule organized even during extremely busy days.

* Maintain control over daily operations.

* Take initiative and continuously improve the way the business operates.

* Balance hands-on work, such as answering calls and scheduling jobs, with managing the entire office.



We are not hiring someone simply to answer the phone. We are hiring someone capable of RUNNING THE OFFICE while also handling day-to-day work.



Mandatory Application Requirements



To be considered, applicants MUST submit all three items below.



1. Updated Resume



Your resume must clearly show your experience working for U.S.-based home services companies and your actual office management responsibilities.



2. Mandatory 2–4 Minute Video Introduction in English



In your video, answer the following questions:



1. What U.S.-based service companies have you worked for, and what services did they provide?

2. What was your exact position, and what were your daily responsibilities?

3. How many technicians and office employees did you manage?

4. What experience do you have with scheduling and dispatching technicians?

5. Have you used Housecall Pro, CallRail, or RingCentral? Explain your experience with each.

6. Describe a difficult customer or operational problem you handled independently.

7. Why do you believe you are qualified to manage our company’s daily office operations?



3. Written Answers



Please answer the following questions in your application:



* How many years of office management experience do you have?

* Which home services industries have you worked in?

* Have you worked directly with U.S. customers?

* Which CRM and phone systems have you used?

* Are you available to work Monday through Saturday, 11 hours per day, during U.S. Central Time?

* Are you comfortable with the starting salary of $1,500 USD per month?



APPLICATIONS WITHOUT THE REQUIRED VIDEO AND DETAILED EXPERIENCE INFORMATION WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Why Join Us?



We are looking for someone interested in a serious, stable, long-term opportunity.



This position offers the opportunity to become an important part of a growing U.S. home services company, take on significant responsibility, and grow professionally based on performance.



If you have real home services management experience, strong communication skills, and the ability to run a busy office independently, we encourage you to apply.

title: Junior Graphic Designer (Full-Time | Canva + Adobe + AI Workflow | Growth Role)
description:
JOB TITLE: Junior Graphic Designer (Full-Time | Canva + Adobe + AI Workflow | Growth Role)



SHIFT: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday–Friday (8:00 PM – 4:00 AM PHT or 9:00 PM – 5:00 AM PHT depending on Daylight Saving Time). Note: The 8:00 AM Eastern clock-in is strict.

HOURS: 40 Hours per Week (Full-Time, Long-Term)

COMPENSATION: $400 USD/month starting rate, increasing to $500 USD/month after a successful 90-day performance review (or up to $500 USD/month starting for candidates with proven WordPress/Elementor skills).



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ABOUT THE ROLE & OUR CULTURE

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We are a US-based digital marketing agency looking for a sharp, dependable Junior Graphic Designer who wants a stable, long-term home to grow their skills. 



No Creepy Trackers: We value autonomy. We do not use time-tracking screenshots, keyloggers, or webcam surveillance. Our culture is built on trust, clear daily outputs, and hitting milestones. In return for that freedom, we expect high accountability, fast communication during shift hours, and strict punctuality at our 8:00 AM Eastern clock-in.



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WHAT YOU WILL DO

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

- Daily High-Velocity Design (70%): Build clean, scroll-stopping social media graphics, ad creatives, presentations, and marketing assets primarily inside Canva.

- Advanced & Print Design (20%): Use Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for photo manipulation, vector work, and setting up print-ready files (flyers, brochures, banners) with proper bleeds, margins, and CMYK specs.

- AI-Powered Branding & Visual Ideation: Use Claude (Claude Design) to structure branding guides and prototype web design layouts, along with ChatGPT and Gemini to generate visual concepts, mood boards, and custom graphic assets before finalizing them in Canva or Adobe.

- Brand Consistency: Follow established client brand kits (fonts, hex codes, tone) without needing constant reminders.

- Daily Standups & Updates: Join a quick 10-to-15-minute daily call in English to review projects, ask questions, and flag roadblocks early.

- Web & Tech Support (10%): Assist with basic graphic uploads or layout tweaks on client websites (training provided if you are eager to learn).



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

- You have a strong visual eye: Even as a junior designer, you understand typography, hierarchy, spacing, and color contrast.

- You are proactive: If a brief is missing a detail, you ask right away or propose a smart solution instead of sitting idle for 4 hours.

- You communicate clearly: You acknowledge messages promptly during working hours and never "ghost" when you hit a snag.

- You use AI as a creative multiplier: We don't do things the slow, manual way. You are comfortable (or eager to learn our workflow) using Claude Design for brand guides and web layout concepts, plus ChatGPT and Gemini for visual ideation and asset creation, and then turning those AI concepts into polished, editable designs.

- You have a reliable setup: A computer that handles Adobe CC smoothly, stable fiber internet, and a backup plan (mobile data hotspot/backup power) for brief outages.



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

NICE-TO-HAVE (BONUS POINTS)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

- Hands-on experience with WordPress and Elementor (translating AI web mockups into live pages)

- Basic UI/web layout skills in Figma

- Prior experience using Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini to build brand kits or layout mockups



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(Applications without a working portfolio link or that skip the instructions below will be automatically archived.)



Send your application with the Subject Line: 

"Junior Designer – [Your First Name] – [Your Favorite Color]"



In the body of your message, include the following:



1. Portfolio Link: Provide a direct link (Behance, Drive, Canva website, or personal site) showing both Digital/Social Media graphics and Print layouts. (Make sure permissions are set to public!)



2. Canva vs. Adobe: In 2 to 3 sentences, tell us what type of design task you prefer doing in Canva for speed, and when you choose to switch over to Photoshop or Illustrator instead.



3. Print Knowledge Check: When preparing a flyer for a professional print shop, what are 2 technical settings you always check before exporting the final PDF?



4. AI Visual Workflow: We use Claude (Claude Design) for branding guides and web design layouts, and ChatGPT / Gemini for generating visual ideas. Have you used any of these tools to brainstorm a design, build a brand guide, or generate graphic assets? Share a quick example of how you turn an AI idea into a finished design.



5. Bonus Skills: Rate your familiarity with WordPress/Elementor from 1 (Never used it) to 5 (Can build pages from scratch). Note: A "1" will not disqualify you!



6. Shift & Rate Confirmation: Confirm that you can commit to the strict 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM US Eastern Time schedule (including daily brief voice/video check-ins) and that the $400–$500 USD/month compensation structure works for you.



7. Tech Setup: Briefly list your computer specs (RAM/Processor) and your backup plan if your main internet goes down during a shift.

title: Content Production Studio for Clothing Brand – Long-Term Partnership
description:
We are an established e-commerce clothing brand looking for content studios, production teams, and small video production companies for an ongoing, long-term partnership.



We need a large and continuous volume of original content for advertising and social media.



We are NOT looking for video editing services.



What we primarily need from you is production: planning shoots, filming high-quality footage, working with models when necessary, and delivering the raw footage to our team.



What We Need



We want to continuously produce different types of content for our clothing brand, including:



* Model/lifestyle shoots

* Fashion B-roll

* Product close-ups

* Clothing detail shots

* Streetwear content

* Indoor and outdoor lifestyle content

* Studio content

* Product-focused content

* Unboxing content

* UGC-style content

* Social media creatives

* Advertising creatives

* Creative product showcases

* Different environments, models, locations, and concepts



Talking content is also valuable if your team has suitable creators/models with good spoken English, but it is not a requirement.



Our business requires new content continuously. We are looking for production partners who can potentially work with us every week or multiple times per month over the long term.



Our priority is being able to consistently produce a high volume of quality footage that our internal creative team can turn into many different advertisements and social media videos.



How We Would Work Together



We will ship our clothing directly to you.



Initially, our team will provide creative references, examples, shot ideas, and general direction.



Your team would then handle the production and send us the raw footage.



Our internal editors will handle post-production.



For example:



We provide references/creative direction → Your team plans the shoot → You arrange the necessary model/location/props → You film → You send us the organized raw footage → Our team handles editing



As our partnership develops, we want our production partners to become increasingly familiar with our brand.



Over time, we would like you to proactively suggest:



* New shoot concepts

* Locations

* Models

* Props

* Interesting environments

* Different ways to showcase our products

* Content ideas based on our previous successful creatives

* New creative directions worth testing



The goal is to eventually have a production partner who understands our brand well enough that we don't need to provide detailed references for every shoot.



Production Capabilities



Ideally, your studio/team can handle some or all of the following:



* Professional video production

* Lighting

* Studio shoots

* Lifestyle/location shoots

* Indoor and outdoor filming

* Male and female models

* Model/talent sourcing

* Location sourcing

* Props

* Creative direction

* High-volume content production

* Organized raw footage delivery



You do NOT necessarily need to provide every service listed above.



If your team is excellent at a specific type of production, we would still like to hear from you.



Models



Access to models is important.



Our products can be filmed with both male and female creators/models depending on the concept.



Not every piece of content requires someone modeling the clothing. For example, creators can also produce unboxings, product-focused shots, detail shots, aesthetic footage, and other concepts.



Please tell us what type of models/talent you currently have access to and whether you can source additional talent based on a creative brief.



Volume & Long-Term Opportunity



We need a significant amount of content and are interested in studios that have the capacity to produce consistently.



There is potential for substantial recurring work if your content performs well and the partnership works smoothly.



When applying, please tell us your production capacity rather than assuming we only need one shoot.



Compensation



We are open to discussing different pricing structures depending on your capabilities and production setup.



This could include:



* Per shoot

* Per content batch

* Day rates

* Monthly production packages

* Retainer arrangements

* Other long-term arrangements



We value long-term relationships and would prefer to establish an efficient recurring production process rather than renegotiating everything for every individual video.



How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Your studio/company name and location.



2. A link to your portfolio with examples of content that your team has personally filmed/produced.



3. A brief description of your team and production capabilities.



4. What cameras, lighting, audio, and other relevant equipment do you use?



5. Do you have your own studio? If yes, please provide photos or examples of the space.



6. Can you source models based on our requirements?



7. How many shoots could your team realistically handle per week or month?



8. What is your typical turnaround time from receiving a brief to delivering raw footage?



9. What is your typical pricing structure? Please provide examples if possible.



We are looking for reliable production partners who can grow with us over the long term.



If your team can consistently produce great content, there is potential for a significant amount of ongoing work.

title: eBay UK Specialist – Listing Optimisation, Account Overhaul & Sales Growth
description:
# eBay UK Specialist – Listing Optimisation, Account Overhaul & Sales Growth



**Work Hours:** Full-Time – 40 Hours per Week (Monday to Friday)  

**Salary:** $4–$6 per hour (depending on experience)  

**Contract:** Initial 3-Month Contract – Potential Long-Term Position  

**Location:** Remote (must be available for occasional UK-time meetings)



## 🚀 Join Our Team as an eBay UK Specialist



We're looking for a highly experienced, proactive **eBay Specialist** to take ownership of a major optimisation project for our established UK e-commerce business.



Our eBay store currently has **2,882 active product listings**, many of which haven't been properly reviewed or optimised for several years. Sales have been declining, and we believe there is significant potential to improve our visibility, conversions and overall sales.



We need someone who can identify what's going wrong, develop a clear improvement strategy and systematically overhaul our existing listings.



**We're not looking for someone who simply uploads products. We want someone who knows how to improve an established eBay business and generate measurable results.**



This is initially a full-time, 3-month contract, with the opportunity for a long-term position based on performance.



## 🔍 What You'll Be Doing



**eBay Account Audit & Strategy**

- Conduct a comprehensive audit of our existing 2,882 listings.

- Analyse sales performance and identify reasons for declining sales.

- Identify poorly performing, outdated and incorrectly optimised listings.

- Prioritise best-selling and high-potential products.

- Research competitors and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Develop a structured plan to systematically improve our catalogue.



**Listing Optimisation & eBay SEO**

- Rewrite and optimise product titles using relevant search keywords.

- Improve descriptions, item specifics, categories and product attributes.

- Optimise listings for eBay UK search visibility.

- Review and improve product variations, including sizes and colours.

- Identify and resolve duplicate listings, listing errors and visibility issues.

- Use eBay bulk editing tools to efficiently improve large numbers of listings.

- Ensure all listings comply with eBay policies.

- Preserve existing listing history wherever appropriate.



**Product Images & Graphic Design**

- Review existing product images and identify improvements.

- Create professional product infographics and size charts.

- Improve product presentation using Canva, Photoshop or similar tools.

- Ensure product images are clear, consistent and suitable for eBay.

- Improve listing presentation to help increase conversions.



**Sales Performance & Competitor Research**

- Analyse impressions, traffic, click-through rates and conversion rates.

- Monitor product sales and identify areas for improvement.

- Research competitor pricing, listings and product presentation.

- Recommend improvements to pricing and promotions.

- Identify opportunities to increase organic sales.

- Track the results of listing changes and optimisation work.



**eBay Advertising – Future Development**

- Initially concentrate on improving organic search visibility and sales.

- Identify listings that may benefit from eBay Promoted Listings in the future.

- Recommend a suitable advertising strategy once priority listings are optimised.

- Do not activate paid advertising without management approval.



**Weekly Reporting & Accountability**

- Maintain a detailed spreadsheet of all listings reviewed and optimised.

- Record improvements and changes made to each listing.

- Provide weekly reports showing work completed and results achieved.

- Track key performance indicators, including impressions, traffic, conversions and sales.

- Attend regular online meetings to discuss progress and priorities.



## ✅ Must-Have Skills & Experience



- Proven hands-on experience managing **eBay UK seller accounts**.

- Strong understanding of eBay SEO and search optimisation.

- Experience improving established eBay accounts with large product catalogues.

- Excellent knowledge of eBay Seller Hub and performance analytics.

- Experience with bulk editing and listing management tools.

- Strong graphic design skills using Canva, Photoshop or similar software.

- Experience optimising product titles, descriptions, images and item specifics.

- Ability to analyse sales data and identify growth opportunities.

- Excellent written English and attention to detail.

- Proactive, organised and able to work independently.

- Reliable internet connection.



## ⭐ Bonus Points For



- Experience selling clothing, workwear, hi-vis clothing or similar products.

- Experience managing listings with multiple sizes and colours.

- Experience turning around an eBay account with declining sales.

- Knowledge of eBay Promoted Listings.

- Experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts.

- A proven track record of increasing organic sales and conversions.



## 🎯 Our Goals for the First 3 Months



**Month 1 – Audit & Initial Improvements**



- Complete a full account audit.

- Identify the main causes of declining sales.

- Prioritise our most important products.

- Begin optimising titles, images, descriptions and item specifics.

- Establish baseline performance metrics.



**Month 2 – Major Listing Overhaul**



- Continue systematically optimising existing listings.

- Use bulk editing tools where appropriate.

- Improve product images, variations and listing presentation.

- Monitor changes in organic visibility and sales.

- Identify further opportunities for improvement.



**Month 3 – Performance & Growth**



- Continue improving the remaining priority listings.

- Analyse results from previous improvements.

- Refine the optimisation strategy based on performance.

- Recommend future advertising opportunities.

- Produce a final progress report and ongoing growth plan.



**Important:** Our priority is improving the products we already have listed. We are not looking for new product sourcing at this stage.



## 🎁 What We Offer



- Full-time remote position – 40 hours per week.

- Competitive hourly pay based on experience.

- Initial 3-month contract with potential for long-term employment.

- Established UK business with a large existing product catalogue.

- Opportunity to take ownership of a major e-commerce improvement project.

- Supportive team and regular communication.

- Freedom to recommend improvements and contribute ideas.

- Opportunity for ongoing work if the project is successful.



## 📩 How to Apply



**Use the subject line: "eBay Specialist + Tiger"**



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction explaining your eBay experience.

2. Your OnlineJobs.ph profile link.

3. Examples of eBay UK accounts you have managed or optimised.

4. Evidence of improvements in sales, traffic or conversions you have achieved.

5. Details of your experience with eBay bulk editing tools.

6. Examples of product listings or images you have improved.

7. A short explanation of how you would approach an established eBay account with 2,882 listings and declining sales.

8. Your expected hourly rate.



**Optional:** Share a short Loom video introducing yourself and explaining your experience.



### Important



We are specifically looking for an experienced eBay specialist who can independently audit, optimise and improve an established account.



**This is not a basic product uploading or general virtual assistant position.**



We want someone who can take responsibility, demonstrate progress and help us return our eBay business to growth.



If you have the experience and confidence to take on this project, we'd love to hear from you!

Job Overview



We are looking for a fast, detail-oriented, and creative Short-Form Video Editor who can handle high-volume editing while maintaining consistent quality.



This role requires more than simply following instructions. We're looking for someone with strong creative judgment who can independently select the best clips, understand which footage works with each hook, and make smart editing decisions without needing constant direction.



Most videos will be approximately 6–10 seconds long, with straightforward edits designed for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and other short-form platforms.

The daily workload will vary depending on the complexity of the videos. Some edits may be simple and quick to complete, while others may require more time and creative consideration.

-Creative judgment: Choose footage that best matches the hook and has the strongest potential to engage viewers.

-Attention to detail: Ensure videos follow the brief and meet the required quality standards.

-Independence: Make sound creative decisions without needing constant supervision.

-Consistency: Apply feedback correctly and avoid repeating the same mistakes.

-Reliability: Deliver work on time and communicate promptly when issues arise.

-Organization: Keep files properly named, organized, and uploaded to the correct folders.

-Proactiveness: Take ownership of your work and flag potential issues before they become problems.



Qualifications

-Experience editing short-form social media videos.

-Strong understanding of short-form content, hooks, and audience engagement.

-Good creative instincts and the ability to select suitable footage for different concepts.

-Ability to work quickly without compromising quality.

-Strong attention to detail and ability to follow instructions.

-Good time management and organizational skills.

-Ability to handle repetitive, high-volume editing tasks.

-Reliable communication and consistent delivery.

-Willingness to receive feedback, learn, and improve.

title: Marketing Automation & Systems Specialist
description:
About Us

We are a growing parenting education company that helps parents of young children move from reactive parenting to clear, repeatable systems that build cooperation, responsibility, emotional security, and self-governance. Our founder is a nationally recognized parenting expert, and our content reaches a large and engaged audience of parents across social media.



Behind that content is a growing set of systems that turn interest into relationships. Social channels feed ManyChat conversations, which feed our CRM,
, checkout, and customer records. Those connections are what allow a parent who watches one video to become a subscriber, a customer, and a long-term member of our community.

We’re looking for a Marketing Automation & Systems Specialist to own those systems and keep them connected, reliable, and working toward real business outcomes.



Position Summary

The Marketing Automation & Systems Specialist is a contract, hands-on role responsible for owning GoHighLevel (LeadConnector), ManyChat,
 automations, CRM workflows, and the integrations between them. You will take business objectives and customer journeys and turn them into working, tested automations, and you will own the health and reliability of that infrastructure rather than waiting for individual tasks to be assigned.

This is a great fit for someone who thinks in systems, uses AI tools as a natural part of their daily technical work, troubleshoots before being asked, and is comfortable operating in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment with high standards for ownership, responsiveness, and execution.



Key Responsibilities

● Independently own GoHighLevel (LeadConnector), ManyChat,
 automations, CRM workflows, and the integrations between them.

● Take a business objective or customer journey and translate it into a working implementation without needing every workflow step designed for you.

● Build and maintain automations across the full customer lifecycle, including lead capture, segmentation, nurture, abandoned checkout, purchase-triggered sequences, onboarding, upsell, and re-engagement.

● Understand how our systems connect, from social to ManyChat to CRM to
 to checkout to Stripe to customer status, and keep data flowing cleanly between them.

● Configure and manage webhooks, APIs, custom fields, tags, triggers, conditions, pipelines, and data passing between systems.

● Use ChatGPT and other AI tools as part of your daily workflow for problem-solving, technical research, documentation, troubleshooting, and implementation.

● Use AI-assisted coding for lightweight technical work such as scripts, API requests, webhook logic, JSON, data transformations, debugging, and small internal tools when that is the fastest way to solve the problem.

● Apply judgment to AI-generated technical work. Know when it is reliable and when it needs to be tested, corrected, or escalated rather than trusted as-is.

● Troubleshoot proactively. Identify broken automations, routing issues, duplicate contacts, bad tagging, failed integrations, and customer-journey problems before leadership has to discover them.

● Test every system end-to-end before considering it complete.

● Review performance data and distinguish between a technical problem, a funnel problem, and an issue that needs to be escalated for a strategic decision.

● Maintain clean system architecture so tags, workflows, fields, and automations stay organized and manageable as the business grows.

● Document what you build so another qualified person can understand and maintain the system.

● Communicate clearly when something is blocked, what you need, and what the consequence of the delay is.

● Take on other systems and automation tasks as they arise. This role is expected to flex based on what the business needs from week to week.



Qualifications

● Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (LeadConnector) or a comparable all-in-one CRM and marketing automation platform, plus ManyChat or a similar conversational automation tool.

● 3-5 years of experience building marketing automations, CRM workflows, or system integrations in a professional or freelance capacity.

● Working knowledge of webhooks, APIs, JSON, custom fields, tags, triggers, and data passing between systems. Experience with Stripe and
 marketing platforms is a plus.

● High proficiency with ChatGPT and other AI tools as a daily part of your technical workflow, including AI-assisted coding for lightweight scripts, API requests, and integrations.

● Ability to use AI to increase execution speed without creating fragile systems or technical debt.

● Understanding of conversion and customer behavior, not just how to operate the software. You should understand why an automation exists and what business outcome it is supposed to produce.

● Strong troubleshooting instincts and attention to detail, with a habit of testing before calling something done.

● Clear written communication and consistent documentation habits.

● Ability to work independently and manage your own priorities in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment.

● Interest in or familiarity with parenting, coaching, or education businesses is a plus.



What Success Looks Like

● The automation infrastructure is reliable. Broken workflows, failed integrations, and data issues are caught and fixed before they reach customers or show up in reporting.

● New customer journeys move from business objective to tested, working automation without leadership designing each step.

● Every stage of the customer lifecycle, from first contact through purchase, onboarding, and re-engagement, is supported by automations that are built, tested, and maintained.

● Data flows cleanly across social, ManyChat, CRM,
, checkout, Stripe, and customer status, with no duplicate contacts, stray tags, or disconnected workflows.

● System architecture stays clean and documented, so the business can scale without accumulating technical debt.

● AI tools measurably increase execution speed while the quality and reliability of what ships stays high.

● Performance data is turned into clear diagnoses: what is a technical fix, what is a funnel problem, and what needs a strategic decision.

● Blockers are surfaced early, with what is needed and what is at stake, so nothing sits stalled.

● The systems are not simply running. They are actively owned, improving over time, and creating a smoother path from first interest to engaged, paying customer.



How to Apply

Please send your résumé to 
 with your résumé, include 2–3 examples of automations, workflows, or integrations you have built in GoHighLevel, ManyChat, or comparable platforms. For each example, briefly describe the business objective, how you designed the system to meet it, and how you tested it.

We are especially interested in your judgment: how you translate a goal into a system, how you d
 what to build versus what to simplify, and how you know when something is truly done.

title: Principal Applied AI Engineer
description:
Principal Applied AI Engineer



Philippines | Fully remote | Full-time, 40 hours/week

Base compensation: USD $4,500–$6,500/month

Start: ASAP, no later than October 22, 2026

Schedule: Monday–Friday; available 9:00 a.m.–noon U.S. Central, with remaining hours flexible.

Required Culture Index survey: 



About CCIA:

Chris Corzo Injury Attorneys is a Louisiana personal injury firm helping injured people secure maximum recovery at speed with felt care. We ranked No. 1,592 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 and No. 80 on the 2026 Inc. Regionals: Southeast.



About the role:

Use AI to transform what a law firm can achieve.



Our ambition is to continually expand what CCIA can accomplish while radically reducing the time, cost, and human effort required, wherever that produces greater risk-adjusted long-term profit.



You will study both AI and CCIA, identify the opportunities with the greatest expected impact relative to alternatives, and personally help turn approved priorities into dependable results. Not more AI for its own sake. The most valuable change next.



This is a hands-on principal engineering role reporting to our Technology Leader, with delegated authority over AI architecture and technical methods.



What you’ll own:

Discover: Continuously research and test AI capabilities, and learn CCIA’s workflows, economics, constraints, and biggest opportunities.

Prioritize: Recommend the highest-impact opportunities and sequence using expected long-term profit, cost, risk, dependencies, and speed to value.

Select: Compare buying, configuring, integrating, building, or waiting. Run the smallest useful test when uncertainty matters.

Deliver: Personally architect, build, integrate, and deploy approved AI solutions, including agentic systems.

Protect: Establish appropriate permissions, evaluations, tests, monitoring, failure recovery, and documentation.

Verify: Work with process owners on adoption and measurable business results; distinguish estimated savings from realized benefit.

Multiply capability: Teach the team, share discoveries, and improve how CCIA develops and operates AI.



What success looks like:

The highest-value opportunities move into reliable use. Results are measured, commitments are met, blockers surface early, and systems remain understandable and maintainable.



Who fits:

You are deeply immersed in AI, independently curious, commercially minded, and technically strong. You challenge assumptions, explain clearly, and own results from discovery through sustained use.



Our values: Own the Results; High Achievers; United Around Shared Success; Prudence, Fortitude, & Temperance.



Who will struggle:

Someone who wants only assigned tickets, research without delivery, or impressive demos without dependable operation and business value.



Experience and qualifications:

Required:

Proven end-to-end delivery and operation of production AI, including a tool-using LLM agent performing real work for actual users.

Strong Python or TypeScript, plus APIs, databases, authentication, Git, testing, and deployment.

Practical command of retrieval, tool use, state, evaluation, and production reliability.

Sound business judgment and clear written and spoken English.



We assess demonstrated capability, not a fixed number of years or a particular degree.



Preferred: Technical leadership, sensitive-data environments, and Filevine, Microsoft 365, or Google Cloud experience.



Compensation:

USD $4,500–$6,500/month, based on demonstrated capability. Exceptional candidates above this range may state their expectations. Final compensation and engagement terms will be agreed in writing.



How to apply:

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject “CCIA Principal AI,” your resume, and one relevant work sample or sanitized case study. Complete the survey linked above and answer:



Survey completed? State “Done” only after completing it.



Which CCIA value describes your work? Give one concrete example.

What recent AI capability did you independently test, and what did you learn?

Describe one production agent you personally delivered: the problem, your contribution, business result, and how you handled failures.

State your location, compensation expectation, earliest start date, and availability for the stated schedule.



Keep answers 2–4 to approximately 300 words combined. Shortlisted candidates complete a technical walkthrough, reference checks, and a scoped paid exercise. AI-assisted work is welcome; you must explain and verify it. Do not share confidential materials.
