title: Senior Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Specialist - Shopify Ecommerce
description:
ABOUT TUFF JUG



Company: Tuff Jug

Job Type: Full-Time, Long-Term

Location: Remote – Philippines

Salary: $1,000–$3,000 USD per month 

Experience: Senior Level – 5+ Years Preferred

English: Exceptional Written and Spoken English



Tuff Jug is a rapidly growing U.S.-based ecommerce brand specializing in innovative utility containers and accessories. We've experienced explosive growth over the past several years and operate a high-volume Shopify Plus store with substantial website traffic. We're looking for a highly experienced Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Specialist to take ownership of improving our website's performance.



This is a dedicated CRO position, not a general ecommerce or virtual assistant role.



THE ROLE



Your primary responsibility will be improving our website's conversion rate, average order value, and revenue per visitor. We want someone who thinks about conversion optimization all day, every day. You'll be responsible for analyzing our website, identifying opportunities, developing testing strategies, executing experiments, and continuously improving the customer experience.



We need someone who can independently lead our CRO efforts. Our leadership team understands ecommerce, but we are not CRO experts and cannot provide technical CRO training.You must already have the experience and confidence to take ownership of this function.



We want someone who brings ideas to the table, challenges assumptions, and proactively identifies improvements without being told what to do.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



                    Website Analysis & Conversion Audits



Conduct thorough, ongoing audits of our Shopify Plus website.



Analyze the entire customer journey, from landing pages to checkout.



Identify friction points, usability issues, and missed conversion opportunities.



Analyze customer behavior using GA4, heatmaps, session recordings, and other tools.



Evaluate mobile and desktop conversion performance.



Identify opportunities based on quantitative and qualitative data.



                             Product Detail Page (PDP) Optimization



Continuously evaluate and improve our product detail pages.



Recommend and test changes to product images, descriptions, headlines, CTAs, layouts, and trust elements.



Improve product education and address customer objections.



Optimize product bundles, upsells, cross-sells, and accessory recommendations.



Identify opportunities to improve add-to-cart rates and purchase completion.



                             A/B Testing & Experimentation



Develop and own a structured CRO testing roadmap.



Create data-backed hypotheses for experiments.



Prioritize tests based on potential impact, confidence, and effort.



Set up, launch, monitor, and analyze A/B tests.



Understand statistical significance, sample sizes, test duration, and experiment validity.



Document results and coordinate implementation of winning variations.



Build a consistent testing program focused on measurable business results.



                             Analytics & Reporting



Analyze Shopify, GA4, and other ecommerce performance data.



Monitor conversion rate, revenue per visitor, average order value, add-to-cart rate, and checkout completion.



Segment results by device, traffic source, landing page, and customer type.



Provide weekly updates covering findings, tests, results, and upcoming priorities.



Clearly explain recommendations and findings to U.S.-based leadership.



                             Continuous Improvement



Research ecommerce conversion strategies and industry best practices.



Proactively identify new testing opportunities.



Recommend improvements to navigation, landing pages, PDPs, cart, and checkout.



Coordinate with creative and development resources to execute changes.



Take full ownership of building and maintaining our CRO program.







REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



Significant hands-on experience in ecommerce conversion rate optimization, preferably 5+ years. Candidates with fewer years but exceptional, documented results will also be considered.



Proven experience improving conversion performance for established ecommerce businesses.



Strong Shopify or Shopify Plus experience.



Extensive experience designing, launching, and analyzing A/B tests.



Advanced understanding of GA4, Shopify analytics, and customer behavior analysis.



Experience with tools such as VWO, Convert, Optimizely, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar platforms.



Strong understanding of ecommerce UX, consumer psychology, and conversion-focused copywriting.



Demonstrated experience optimizing product detail pages for physical consumer products.



Ability to independently develop, prioritize, and execute a CRO roadmap.



Outstanding spoken and written English, including the ability to clearly communicate complex ideas with U.S.-based leadership.



Highly analytical, proactive, organized, and results-driven.



Experience with GemPages, Shopify theme editing, and basic HTML/CSS is a plus, but not required.







WHO THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR 



We are not looking for:



General Shopify virtual assistants.



Web designers without substantial CRO experience.



Paid advertising specialists looking to transition into CRO.



Candidates who have only completed CRO courses.



Consultants who only produce audits without helping execute improvements.



Individuals who require extensive training or daily direction.



We need a proven CRO professional who can independently lead this function.







WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 



Within your first 90 days, you should be able to:



Complete a comprehensive audit of our website and customer journey.



Develop a prioritized CRO roadmap.



Launch meaningful A/B tests based on identified opportunities.



Begin implementing improvements to our highest-impact product pages.



Establish a consistent experimentation and reporting process.



Long term, your success will be measured by the quality of your experimentation program and measurable improvements in website performance and revenue per visitor.







COMPENSATION



Salary: $1,000–$3,000 USD per month, depending on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated results.



This is a full-time, long-term position with:



Competitive compensation based on experience.



Opportunity for compensation growth based on performance.



Direct collaboration with company leadership.



Significant ownership and autonomy.



The opportunity to make a measurable impact on a rapidly growing ecommerce brand.



A stable, long-term role with growth opportunities.







HOW TO APPLY 



Generic applications will not be considered.



Please include the following:



Your experience: How many years have you worked specifically in ecommerce CRO? Which Shopify or ecommerce brands have you worked with?



Your results: Describe two actual A/B tests you personally managed. Include the problem, hypothesis, test implementation, results, and how you validated those results. Share specific performance metrics whenever possible.



Your tools: Which CRO, analytics, heatmap, and A/B testing platforms have you personally used?



Your strategy: If you joined an established Shopify store generating substantial monthly revenue, what would your first 30 days look like?



Your communication: Include a 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and walking us through one successful CRO experiment you've personally managed. We will use this to evaluate both your expertise and your English communication skills. If you do not submit a video, we will not consider your application. 



Your compensation: Provide your expected monthly salary in USD and your earliest available start date.



Important: Begin your application with the words "Conversion First" so we know you've read the full posting.



We're looking for an exceptional CRO professional who wants to take ownership, drive meaningful results, and build a long-term career with a growing U.S. ecommerce company.



If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

Landlord Lead Generation / Data Mining Specialist

title: Abandoned Cart Team Leader — Build Your Own Team From Zero
description:
Abandoned Cart Team Leader — Build Your Own Team From Zero

 Olavita · Remote · Commission-heavy

We're not hiring agents. We're hiring the people who will build the agent teams.

If you want a fixed salary, a script handed to you, and a manager checking your call count — this isn't for you, and we'd rather you knew in paragraph two than in week three.

If you've built a phone sales team before, know exactly how you'd do it again, and have been waiting for someone to hand you a stream of warm leads and get out of your way — keep reading.

What you're walking into

Olavita is an established skincare and beauty brand selling subscriptions to customers across the US and UK. We're profitable, growing, and we've been leaving money on the table by not having a phone team.

Every day, people reach our checkout, enter their details, and don't complete. Right now they get an
 and that's it. Nobody calls them.

That's your entire book of business. These people read the advertorial, watched the sales page, and got as far as entering their card. You are never cold calling. You're calling someone who already d
 to buy and got interrupted.

Most of our customers are women aged 60 to 80. They grew up ordering by phone. They don't want a portal or a chatbot — they want to talk to a person. We have a large and growing catalog, so you're never limited to recovering what they left behind.

Our current phone capability is two people answering inbound. Everything else is yours to build.

What you'll own

Your team calls people who reached checkout and stopped. You find out what stopped them, you address it, and you close.

Three things, in order:

Recover the cart. The baseline job, and the one we measure first.

Close higher than they abandoned. Recovery is the floor, not the goal. The catalog is there to be used where it genuinely fits the customer.

Convert one-time purchases to subscriptions. Most of our customers already choose a subscription, so this is the smaller piece — but it's worth real money when it lands.

You own the scripts. You own the training. You own the hiring of your own agents once you've proven the model works.

How this works

Phase one is you, on the phone, personally. No team yet.

This isn't a trial by fire — it's how you learn what actually sells to our customer. You'll hear the real objections, find the language that lands, and discover the pace an older customer needs. That becomes your script. We've seen leaders write excellent playbooks for the wrong customer, and it costs everyone months.

You'll have a personal production target for this phase, set with you once we've both seen real conversion data. It'll be a clear number and you'll know it from day one of the phase. No moving goalposts in either direction.

Phase two: you build your team. Hit the bar and you start hiring agents underneath you. You own their recruitment, their scripts, their training, their numbers — and you earn an override on everything they produce.

We expect a performing leader to be running eight to ten agents. That's where the money is, and we'd rather tell you that now than have you aim at five.

We're hiring two to three leaders at once. You'll be measured against each other. If you're any good, you'll think that's fair.

What success looks like

Recovery rate — share of assigned carts recovered, measured against what our
 flows already recover on their own

Average order value on recovered carts — recovery is the floor, upsell is the job

Subscription conversion on carts that were one-time purchases

Refund and chargeback rate on your team's orders

Quality and compliance — accurate orders, appropriate offers, clear documentation

Targets are set after we've reviewed call volume, lead quality and conversion baselines together. We calibrate honestly and we tell you the number.

Our sales philosophy — read this part properly

We want leaders who know how to sell, not manage call counts. Find out what stopped them, address it, present the offer with confidence. Then teach your team to do it.

And: every recommendation is honest, every price is verified, and every customer who says no gets to say no. A sale we refund two weeks later isn't a sale — it's a chargeback, a bad review, and a customer lost permanently. We track it, and it's in your team's numbers.

Our customers are older women who trust us with their money and their skin. We'd rather lose a sale than earn one we shouldn't have. If that sounds like a constraint you can sell inside, we'll get on well.

Who we want

You've built or led a phone sales or inside-sales team. Done it, not studied it.

You can write a script that sounds like a human. Our customer is 72 and will hang up on anything corporate.

Excellent spoken and written English, warm and unhurried on the phone. Our customers are not in a rush. If you sound like you're rushing them, they'll end the call and so will we.

Comfortable being measured on hard numbers in short windows.

Experience in beauty, skincare, wellness or subscriptions is an advantage, not a requirement.

Reliable computer, headset, stable internet, backup connectivity and power.

Available for US calling hours, six days a week — our customers are often easiest to reach at weekends.

What we don't care about: degrees, years-of-experience counts, country, or whether you've worked somewhere we've heard of. We hire globally and pay on performance, not postcode.

The money

$1,000/month base, recoverable against commission — capped at 50% of your monthly commission, so you never go backwards in a slow month.

10% of total order value on every cart you personally recover. Uncapped.

4% override on your team's total production once you have a team. Uncapped.

Commission is paid 30 days after the order, provided it hasn't been refunded or charged back. Standard, and it means we're both paid on revenue we actually keep.

We're explicit about the recoverable draw because it tells you what kind of person we want. If "I earn it back from my own performance" sounds like a problem, we're not a fit. If it sounds like free money, we should talk.

The base is the floor, not the ceiling. A leader running eight to ten producing agents should be earning several multiples of it. We've paid individual team members five figures in a single month.

How to apply

Send your CV along with a 3-minute recording (Loom, video, or voice note). The recording is mandatory — applications without one won't be reviewed.

In the recording:

The last phone team you built or ran — size, what it sold, what the numbers were.

Roleplay, out loud, actual words: a 71-year-old woman reached our checkout yesterday with a $105 subscription in her cart and didn't complete. You're calling her now. Go.

Roleplay, out loud: same call, and her first response is "Oh, I d
 it was too expensive." Keep going.

What you'd need from us in your first two weeks to hit the ground running.

If you describe your approach instead of speaking the words in 2 and 3, we'll assume you can't do it.

Good applications get a reply within 48 hours.

Send

2+ years retouching for female creators, models or influencers. Show us before/afters.

Full-time, 40 h/week, Hubstaff time tracking, Wise payouts every two weeks.

title: Full-Time General Manager / Head of Operations | UK Financial Firm
description:
A growing Europe-based financial firm is looking for a highly experienced Full-Time General Manager / Head of Operations to work directly with the CEO and take responsibility for the day-to-day running of the business.



THIS IS A SENIOR MANAGEMENT POSITION.



This is NOT a Virtual Assistant role.

This is NOT an Executive Assistant role.

This is NOT an entry-level management role.



We are looking for someone who has already managed employees, business operations, KPIs, sales performance, company processes and daily operational activity.



The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the company operates efficiently every day without the CEO having to personally manage every employee, chase routine tasks or solve every operational problem.



You must be confident making decisions, managing staff, solving problems, improving systems, monitoring performance and holding employees accountable.



The CEO will remain responsible for overall strategy and major business decisions.



YOU will be responsible for making sure the business runs properly.





SALARY:



£5GBP-£7GBP per hour



Salary will depend on experience and proven ability.





WORKING HOURS:



Monday to Friday



9:00 AM – 5:00 PM UK TIME



40 HOURS PER WEEK



FULL-TIME ONLY



You must be available and responsive throughout working hours.



You must be able to START WITHIN THE NEXT 7 DAYS.





MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:





DAILY BUSINESS OPERATIONS:



- Take responsibility for the day-to-day running of the company

- Manage daily and weekly operational priorities

- Ensure employees complete their responsibilities

- Monitor deadlines and outstanding tasks

- Identify operational problems and resolve them quickly

- Build and improve company systems

- Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

- Make routine operational decisions independently

- Ensure the company remains organised, productive and accountable

- Reduce unnecessary CEO involvement in routine operational matters





STAFF MANAGEMENT:



- Directly manage company employees

- Assign responsibilities and priorities

- Monitor staff performance

- Follow up incomplete work

- Hold employees accountable for targets and deadlines

- Conduct staff meetings

- Monitor attendance and productivity

- Address performance issues

- Support recruitment and onboarding

- Assist with disciplinary and performance-management processes where required

- Identify when additional employees are required

- Ensure every employee understands their responsibilities





KPI & PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT:



- Create clear KPIs for employees

- Monitor daily, weekly and monthly performance

- Identify underperformance quickly

- Implement performance improvement plans

- Review staff productivity

- Prepare management reports

- Track results against targets

- Ensure employees are producing measurable results rather than simply appearing busy





SALES OPERATIONS:



- Oversee the B2B sales function

- Monitor sales activity and performance

- Review CRM activity

- Monitor sales follow-ups

- Ensure opportunities are being progressed

- Review the sales pipeline

- Track meetings, opportunities, conversions and signed clients

- Hold sales employees accountable for results

- Identify problems affecting sales performance

- Work with the sales team to improve results





LEAD GENERATION OVERSIGHT:



- Manage the lead generation / research employee

- Ensure lead information is accurate

- Monitor lead quantity and quality

- Ensure decision-maker information is properly researched

- Prevent duplicate, poor-quality or fabricated data entering the CRM

- Ensure the sales team has sufficient quality prospects to contact





CRM MANAGEMENT:



- Ensure CRM records are accurate and updated

- Monitor lead and client stages

- Check employee CRM activity

- Ensure calls,
s, follow-ups and next actions are recorded

- Ensure opportunities are not forgotten

- Maintain consistent CRM standards across the business





CLIENT & CASE OPERATIONS:



- Oversee new client onboarding

- Ensure client information and documents are properly recorded

- Monitor active client matters

- Ensure client communication is professional and timely

- Oversee the operational handover from sales to service delivery

- Monitor case progress

- Ensure important issues are escalated appropriately





FINANCIAL & BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION:



- Monitor operational expenses and subscriptions

- Review basic company financial reports

- Work with bookkeeping/accounting support when required

- Monitor invoices and payment administration

- Maintain accurate operational and financial records

- Identify unnecessary business costs

- Provide the CEO with clear company performance summaries





CEO REPORTING:



You will report directly to the CEO.



The CEO should NOT need to spend every day asking:



What is each employee doing?

Has this task been completed?

Why has this client not been followed up?

Why has the CRM not been updated?

Why are targets being missed?

Who is responsible for this problem?



You will be expected to know the answers.



You will provide a clear weekly management report covering:



- Staff performance

- Sales performance

- Lead generation

- Client activity

- KPIs

- Operational problems

- Outstanding priorities

- Decisions requiring CEO approval





MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS:



- MINIMUM 5 YEARS' PROVEN SENIOR MANAGEMENT / OPERATIONS EXPERIENCE

- COMPLETED BACHELOR'S DEGREE OR HIGHER – REQUIRED

- Previous experience as a General Manager, Operations Manager, Head of Operations, COO, Business Manager or directly comparable senior position

- Proven experience managing multiple employees

- Proven experience managing KPIs

- Proven experience holding employees accountable for performance

- Proven experience managing daily business operations

- Experience creating and improving SOPs

- Experience with CRM systems

- Experience overseeing sales or business development

- Experience preparing management reports

- Strong understanding of business operations

- Strong leadership ability

- Strong problem-solving ability

- Excellent written English

- Excellent spoken English

- Excellent organisation

- Strong professional judgement

- Ability to make decisions independently

- Ability to manage multiple priorities

- Ability to work without constant supervision

- High level of confidentiality

- Verifiable employment history

- Professional references





PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:



Experience within any of the following would be advantageous:



- Financial services

- B2B services

- Commercial collections

- Credit control

- Accounts receivable

- Sales operations

- Business development

- Construction-related businesses

- Professional services

- Remote team management

- UK companies or UK clients





THIS ROLE IS NOT SUITABLE FOR SOMEONE WHO:



- Has less than 5 years relevant management experience

- Has never managed employees

- Has only worked as a Virtual Assistant

- Has only worked as an Executive Assistant

- Has never managed KPIs

- Is looking for their first management position

- Avoids difficult conversations with employees

- Cannot make decisions independently

- Requires constant instructions from the CEO

- Cannot manage multiple business functions

- Has no experience improving business processes





IMPORTANT:



THIS IS A SENIOR MANAGEMENT POSITION.



We are NOT looking for someone to learn how to become a manager.



We are looking for someone who already knows how to manage employees and RUN DAILY BUSINESS OPERATIONS.



You will receive training on our specific company, services, systems and internal processes.



We will NOT train you in basic management, leadership or operations.



Previous employment, job titles, degree, responsibilities and references may be verified.



Please DO NOT apply with false, exaggerated or unverifiable experience.



False or materially misleading information may result in rejection of your application and may be reported to OnlineJobs.ph where appropriate.





HOW TO APPLY:



⚠️ MINIMUM 30 APPLY POINTS REQUIRED



⚠️ APPLICATION CODE REQUIRED:



COO30-UKOPS26



You MUST place this code at the VERY TOP of your application:



COO30-UKOPS26



Applications using fewer than 30 Apply Points will NOT be considered.



Applications without the correct application code will NOT be considered.





PLEASE ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS:





QUESTION 1:



How many years have you worked in senior management or operations positions?





QUESTION 2:



What is your CURRENT job?



By CURRENT, we mean the job you are working in RIGHT NOW today.



Please provide:



- Job title

- Industry

- Date started

- Full-time / part-time / freelance

- Working days

- Exact working hours





QUESTION 3:



What is the highest-level management position you have held and how long did you remain in that position?





QUESTION 4:



How many employees did you personally manage in your most recent management position?





QUESTION 5:



What KPIs were you personally responsible for monitoring?





QUESTION 6:



Give one specific example of an underperforming employee you managed.



Explain:



- What the problem was

- What YOU personally did

- What the final result was





QUESTION 7:



Give one specific example of a business process or SOP you personally created or improved.



Explain:



- What was wrong before

- What you changed

- What measurable result was achieved





QUESTION 8:



Describe your experience managing sales staff or overseeing a sales department.



Include any sales targets, conversion figures, revenue targets or KPIs you monitored.





QUESTION 9:



Which CRM, project-management, finance and business-management systems have you used?





QUESTION 10:



Give one example of an important business problem you solved independently without waiting for the CEO or business owner to tell you what to do.





QUESTION 11:



What Bachelor's Degree or higher qualification do you hold?



Please provide:



- Degree

- University

- Year graduated





QUESTION 12:



If you joined a company where the CEO was involved in too many daily operational tasks, what would you do during your FIRST 30 DAYS to reduce the CEO's involvement while maintaining control of the business?





QUESTION 13:



Are you currently working for any other employer, client or business?



If yes, provide the working days and hours for EACH commitment.





QUESTION 14:



Are you available Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM UK time, 40 hours per week, without conflict with another job?





QUESTION 15:



Can you start within the next 7 days?





QUESTION 16:



Please provide your WhatsApp number including country code.





FINAL WARNING:



You must:



- Use at least 30 Apply Points

- Include code COO30-UKOPS26

- Answer ALL 16 questions

- Hold a completed Bachelor's Degree or higher

- Have at least 5 years relevant senior management / operations experience

- Be available full-time Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM UK time

- Be able to start within 7 days



Incomplete applications will NOT progress.



Applicants who do not meet the mandatory requirements will not be invited to interview.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Operations Manager (Remote, Philippines) — Job Posting





Apply here: 



The Lacy Employment Law Firm is hiring a Philippines-based Operations Manager to own the firm's operational accountability — the person who makes sure the work gets done, the systems keep running, and problems get caught before they cost us.



About the firm

The Lacy Employment Law Firm (LELF) is a plaintiff-side employment litigation boutique representing employees in discrimination, retaliation, whistleblower, and wage cases, with offices in Philadelphia and Pittsburgh and a growing overseas support team. We run on tight systems and clear metrics, and we're scaling fast — this role exists to keep the machine running cleanly as we grow.



About the role

We're hiring an Operations Manager to own the firm's operational accountability layer — the single person responsible for making sure work actually gets done, systems actually keep running, and problems get caught and fixed before they cost us. You'll supervise our overseas team, own the firm's operational metrics, and report directly to the Managing Attorney.

One principle defines this job: running systems don't stay running. We need someone who verifies rather than assumes — who confirms the automations fired, the deadlines are covered, and the numbers are real — and who raises problems early with a proposed fix instead of waiting to be asked. If you're the kind of person who notices what everyone else missed, this is your seat.



Quick facts

• Reports to: Managing Attorney (Andrew Lacy, Jr.)

• Supervises: the firm's overseas virtual assistant team (currently ~6)

• Hours: full-time, aligned to US Eastern business hours (approx. 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET)

• Location: remote, Philippines-based

• Employment: direct hire — LELF is your employer (not an agency or contractor arrangement), with full statutory benefits under Philippine law (see Compensation & benefits)



What you'll own

• Monitoring & accountability (the core). Verify that recurring systems and automations are actually running, that no filing or docket deadline is slipping, and that each process owner completed their checks on schedule. Catch silent failures early and escalate with a proposed fix.

• Team supervision. Assign and balance work across the VA team, serve as their first point of contact for questions and escalation, run regular check-ins, and hold the team to clear, measurable standards — including honest feedback when work slips.

• Metrics & reporting. Own the weekly operational scorecard: pull the numbers (intake pipeline, conversion, turnaround, docket throughput), confirm they're accurate, and report status and risks to the Managing Attorney.

• Systems, vendors & access. Track software subscriptions, renewals, and costs; vet new vendors and tools before adoption; and manage team access and credentials — onboarding/offboarding, the password vault, and keeping everyone on firm-approved systems only.

• People operations. Onboard and offboard team members, coordinate coverage and leave, and recruit and screen new VAs as the team grows.

• Process & documentation. Build and maintain SOPs and checklists so recurring work is repeatable and nothing depends on one person's memory.

Out of scope: substantive legal work, client funds, and trust accounting are handled by the attorneys. This role supports and monitors operations — it does not practice law or touch client trust accounts.



Who you are

• Proactive by default. You notice when something's off without being told, and you'd rather flag a problem early than hope it resolves itself. This is the single most important trait for the role.

• Comfortable holding people accountable — including giving direct feedback and escalating bad news upward. You can be respectful and firm at the same time.

• Organized and systems-minded. You like checklists, dashboards, and turning messy processes into repeatable ones.

• Strong written and spoken English, able to turn a quick instruction into a clear task and a clear status update.

• 3+ years in operations, team coordination, legal support, or a similar role — ideally supervising a remote team.

• Comfortable with tools like Airtable, Slack, and automation platforms, or a fast learner eager to master them.



Nice to have

• Experience in a law firm or professional-services environment, especially US litigation support.

• Familiarity with discovery/litigation workflows, docketing, or legal project management.

• Experience building SOPs or managing SaaS tools and vendors.

Compensation & benefits

• Competitive monthly salary, commensurate with experience. (Range to confirm: ₱[]–₱[]/month.)

• Direct employment by LELF with full statutory benefits under Philippine labor law, including SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG contributions; 13th-month pay; service incentive leave and holiday pay; and a night-shift differential for hours worked between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM (which US Eastern hours will include).

• On top of statutory benefits, we offer [HMO/health coverage, paid time off above the statutory minimum, and an equipment/internet allowance].

• A senior seat with real ownership and room to grow as the firm scales.

You are a regular, directly-employed team member — not a contractor and not placed through an agency.

title: Frontend Manager / COO: E-commerce Operations
description:
ABOUT US

We run multiple Shopify stores in fashion and home decor, selling internationally through Google Shopping. We're a small, fully remote team looking for an experienced operator to take ownership of the day-to-day business.



THE ROLE

You'll manage the operation of the business and own the "frontend": everything a customer sees before they buy. You lead the listing team, work closely with our Backend Manager (customer service, suppliers, fulfillment) and report directly to the founder. The founder sets the goals and direction; you own the execution.



This is a senior role. We're looking for an A-player who thinks like an owner, not someone who waits for instructions.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Operations & leadership

- Translate company goals into targets, plans and weekly priorities

- Coordinate between departments and keep projects moving: scope, deadlines, follow-up

- Lead team meetings and report on progress and performance

- Write and improve SOPs so the team can work independently

- Hire, onboard, train and evaluate team members

- Spot problems and bottlenecks early and fix them



Products & listings

- Product research and selection: find and test new products and trends

- Oversee product listings: titles, descriptions, images, size charts, product details

- Keep catalogs clean: remove underperformers, refresh and improve existing listings

- Quality control on the team's output



Store optimization & growth

- Improve store conversion: product pages, collections, navigation, trust elements, offers

- Competitor research: pricing, products, store design, promotions

- Plan seasonal and promotional campaigns (e.g. Black Friday, holidays)

- Support new store launches and expansion into new markets



Pricing, data & performance

- Manage pricing and margins across stores and markets

- Monitor KPIs: revenue, conversion rate, margins, product performance

- Use data to d
 what to scale, fix or stop

- Work with ad agencies, media buyers and other partners on product feeds and performance



MUST-HAVES

- 4+ years of hands-on Shopify e-commerce experience

- 2+ years managing a team (hiring, training, setting targets, giving feedback)

- Proven track record of growing a store or e-commerce operation: you can show concrete results (revenue, conversion, margin or efficiency improvements)

- Experience running multiple stores or a large product catalog at the same time

- Strong analytical skills: you work confidently with P&L numbers, margins, conversion rates and large Google Sheets

- Experience writing SOPs and building processes that others follow

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Highly organized and reliable: you deliver what you commit to, on time, without reminders

- Available full-time with overlap during European business hours

- Stable internet and a backup power/internet solution



NICE-TO-HAVES

- Dropshipping experience (fashion or home decor)

- Knowledge of Google Shopping, Google Merchant Center and product feeds

- Experience with multi-market / multi-currency selling (UK, US, EU, AU)

- Experience working with suppliers or sourcing agents in China

- Experience using AI tools to automate or speed up work

- Basic design eye: you know what makes a product page convert



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR

- You're used to only executing tasks someone else hands you

- You haven't managed people before

- You're looking for a side job next to other clients



TOOLS WE USE

Shopify, Google Sheets, Notion, Slack and our own internal tools



WHAT WE OFFER

- Full-time, long-term remote position

- Competitive monthly pay based on experience, with regular performance reviews

- Real ownership and a direct line to the founder

- Room to grow with the company



HOW TO APPLY

Send your CV plus a short message (max 200 words) covering:

1. Your Shopify / e-commerce experience and the stores you've worked on

2. A team you've managed and one concrete result you achieved (with numbers)

3. Your expected hourly rate

Start your message with "Blue" so we know you read the full post.

title: Accountant / Bookkeeper
description:
Accounting Manager / Controller (U.S. Accounting)

Full-Time | Remote, Philippines | Long-Term Career Opportunity

Salary: Competitive, based on experience and qualifications

Schedule: Flexible, with availability for meetings with our U.S. team

About Our Company

Promofect is a growing U.S.-based company with approximately $2+ million in annual

revenue. We specialize in custom branded apparel, promotional products, and online

merchandise stores.

We operate through two brands, Promofect and New York Rush Shirts, serving

customers ranging from small businesses to large organizations. Our business

combines B2B sales, e-commerce, in-house production, and outsourced manufacturing.

We're looking for an experienced accounting professional who can take ownership of

our accounting operations, improve our financial systems, and help us build a stronger

foundation for continued growth.

About the Opportunity

Currently, our accounting and finance functions are managed directly by the company

owner, who has a professional background in accounting and finance.

We're looking for someone who can take over the day-to-day accounting

responsibilities, maintain accurate financial records, develop better reporting, and

continuously improve our processes.

The owner will continue overseeing higher-level financial strategy, but we want

someone who can independently manage the accounting function without requiring

constant supervision or technical accounting guidance.

We can teach you our business. We expect you to already know accounting.

We're not a large corporation with separate departments for every function. At our

current size, this position requires someone comfortable wearing multiple hats, handling

both detailed accounting work and broader financial projects.

As the company grows, some responsibilities may transition to additional team

members. The right candidate will have the opportunity to help build the systems,

procedures, and team that support a much larger business.

Key Responsibilities

1. Accounting & Financial Operations



 Take ownership of our daily accounting operations using QuickBooks Online.

 Manage transaction categorization, accounts payable, and accounts receivable.

 Oversee Bill.com, vendor payments, invoicing, and collections.

 Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, payment processors, and transactions

from our various sales platforms.

 Manage month-end closing and maintain accurate financial statements in

accordance with U.S. GAAP.

 Maintain accurate general ledger records and proper accrual accounting.

 Review existing accounting processes, identify errors or inefficiencies, and make

improvements.

 Maintain strong financial controls and organized supporting documentation.

2. Financial Reporting & Analysis

 Prepare accurate daily sales and revenue reports across our different business

channels.

 Maintain financial reports, dashboards, and management reporting.

 Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and budget-versus-actual analysis.

 Monitor cash flow, upcoming payments, and financial obligations.

 Develop reporting that helps us understand profitability by customer, order,

product category, and business segment.

 Analyze order costs, including products, outsourced manufacturing, in-house

production, and shipping.

 Work with management to improve our pricing models using actual financial

results.

 Help connect revenue and profitability reporting with sales and marketing data.

3. Tax Compliance & Financial Administration

We have outside U.S. CPAs and tax professionals who handle our business income tax

returns and provide specialized tax advice. You will coordinate with these professionals

rather than replace them.

Responsibilities include:



 Manage ongoing sales tax reporting and filing processes across applicable U.S.

states.

 Help maintain and improve sales tax compliance as the company grows.

 Recognize potential compliance issues and coordinate with outside advisors

when needed.

 Manage W-9 collection and 1099 preparation and filing.

 Maintain accurate reporting for customer revenue-sharing programs and related

payouts.

 Coordinate with outside accountants and tax professionals to ensure accurate

and timely reporting.

4. Systems, Technology & Automation

We use several software platforms, including:

 QuickBooks Online

 Bill.com

 Printavo

 InkSoft

 Chipply

Some of these platforms support e-commerce and online merchandise stores, making

accurate reconciliation and consolidated reporting especially important.

We want someone who is comfortable with technology and enthusiastic about improving

processes.

Responsibilities include:

 Identify accounting tasks that can be simplified or automated.

 Use AI, automation tools, and software integrations to improve reporting,

accuracy, and efficiency.

 Improve the flow of financial information between our systems.

 Build reliable, repeatable processes that reduce manual work.

 Continuously suggest and implement practical improvements.



Advanced AI development experience is not required. However, curiosity, strong

technical aptitude, and a genuine willingness to learn and use modern tools are

important.

5. Payroll & Administrative Support

As a growing company, we also need flexibility across certain administrative and HR-

related responsibilities.

You'll work alongside existing team members to help oversee:

 Employee time tracking and payroll processing.

 Sales commissions, bonuses, and incentive calculations.

 Payroll-related reconciliations and records.

 Employee administrative records and important milestones.

 Other finance-related administrative processes as needed.

These responsibilities may evolve or be delegated as the company grows.

Required Qualifications

 At least 5 years of professional accounting experience, including significant

experience working with U.S.-based businesses.

 Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and accrual accounting.

 Advanced QuickBooks Online experience.

 Proven ability to independently manage full-cycle accounting and monthly

closing.

 Experience preparing accurate financial statements and performing account

reconciliations.

 Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

 Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.

 Excellent written and spoken English.

 Strong attention to detail, accountability, and organizational skills.

 Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and make sound

accounting decisions.

Preferred, but Not Required



 Experience as an Accounting Manager, Controller, Assistant Controller, or senior

accountant with broad responsibilities.

 Experience in e-commerce, distribution, manufacturing, or order-based

businesses.

 Experience with cost accounting, job costing, budgeting, and financial analysis.

 Familiarity with U.S. sales tax compliance.

 Experience with AI, automation, reporting tools, or software integrations.

 Experience improving accounting systems for a growing small business.

 Previous experience supervising or training accounting staff.

A CPA qualification is not required. Demonstrated accounting competence and real-

world experience are more important to us.

Who We're Looking For

The right person is an experienced accounting professional who enjoys taking

ownership and improving the way things work.

You're comfortable handling everyday accounting transactions, but you also enjoy

analyzing financial information, building better reports, and finding opportunities to

improve the business.

You don't need to be an expert in every area of finance, technology, or tax. You do need

to be resourceful, understand your responsibilities, recognize when specialized advice

is needed, and take initiative to get things done.

We're especially interested in someone who has worked in a growing business and

understands the need to balance day-to-day responsibilities with building better systems

for the future.

We value independent thinking, accuracy, reliability, efficiency, and a willingness to

continuously improve.

Growth Opportunity

This position will initially report directly to the company owner.

Our goal is to develop an organized, accurate, and efficient accounting function that can

support the company as it grows.

Over time, you may have the opportunity to supervise additional accounting staff and

take on broader responsibilities.



As the company expands, we may eventually introduce additional senior financial

leadership. Our goal is for this position to remain an important part of a strong and

scalable finance department.

We're looking for someone who wants to grow their career with us and become a

valued, long-term member of our team.

This is a full-time position dedicated to our company, not a freelance opportunity.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and answer the following questions. We're looking for

specific examples from your actual professional experience rather than generic

responses.

1. Accounting Experience

Describe your experience managing accounting for U.S.-based companies. Have you

independently handled the full accounting cycle, including monthly closing and financial

statements?

2. Ownership & Problem-Solving

Tell us about a time you took over an accounting function, discovered problems, or

improved existing processes. What did you personally accomplish?

3. Financial Reporting & Analysis

Describe your experience with budgeting, financial reporting, job costing, or profitability

analysis. Have you built reports that helped management make better financial

decisions?

4. Technology & Automation

Have you used AI, automation, or other technology to improve accounting processes?

Share a specific example, or explain what types of improvements you're interested in

implementing.

5. Working in a Growing Business

Are you comfortable being hands-on with daily accounting while also helping with

payroll, reporting, and other administrative responsibilities as needed? Describe any

similar experience.

6. Compensation & Availability

What is your expected monthly salary in USD, and when would you be available to

start?



We're looking for someone who can take ownership, deliver accurate work,

improve our processes, and grow with our company. Qualified finalists may be

asked to complete a paid practical accounting assessment.

title: High-Ticket Sales Closers
description:
Looking for confident, driven *High-Ticket Sales Closers* to work remotely with North American companies.



### Who We’re Looking For

* *Strong spoken English is a MUST*

* Previous sales/closing experience preferred

* Confident speaking with North American customers

* Strong objection-handling skills

title: IT Support Specialist – Dental Practice Operations

1. Denticon Administration and Support



-Create, configure, modify, and deactivate Denticon user accounts.

-Manage user permissions and access across multiple office locations.

-Configure provider profiles and access to clinical schedules.

-Troubleshoot login failures, software freezing, and application errors.

-Investigate issues with treatment posting, procedure entry, and provider access.

-Identify system-wide outages and communicate with Denticon technical support.

-Ensure employee and provider access is configured according to authorized job responsibilities.



2. Dental Imaging and Clinical Technology

-Support iTero and intraoral scanner connectivity and software-related problems.

-Assist with panoramic X-ray and other dental imaging equipment integrations.

-Install and configure imaging software, drivers, and updates.

-Troubleshoot communication problems between imaging equipment and dental workstations.

-Support AirParrot and other approved screen-sharing or display applications.

-Coordinate with equipment manufacturers or onsite technicians when physical repairs are required.



3. Phone Systems and Communications

-Troubleshoot browser-based softphone and VoIP systems.

-Resolve issues involving calls not ringing, dropped calls, unavailable inbound/outbound calling, and incorrect routing.

-Configure headsets, microphones, speakers, and browser audio permissions.

-Troubleshoot voi
, call transfers, missed-call routing, and SMS communication systems.

-Assist with assigning appropriate phone access to employees and office locations.

-Coordinate with phone-system vendors when necessary.

-Perform inbound and outbound test calls to verify successful resolution.



4. Computer, Printer, and Scanner Support

-Troubleshoot Windows desktops, laptops, and workstation performance issues.

-Diagnose operating-system errors, startup problems, application crashes, and hardware connectivity issues.

-Install and configure printers, document scanners, drivers, and related software.

-Troubleshoot printing failures, scanner connection errors, and device compatibility issues.

-Configure workstations for new employees and office locations.

-Assist onsite staff with basic hardware troubleshooting through remote guidance.

-Research and recommend compatible replacement equipment when needed.



5. Network and Internet Connectivity

-Diagnose internet outages, Wi-Fi problems, and network connectivity failures.

-Troubleshoot network-connected printers, tablets, imaging devices, and computers.

-Assist with router, switch, and access-point configurations.

-Support UniFi or comparable network management systems.

-Coordinate with internet providers and onsite service personnel.

-Assist with keeping business devices separated from guest networks where appropriate.



6. Employee Onboarding and Offboarding

-Create and configure employee accounts in Denticon, Google Workspace, and other authorized platforms.

-Assign access to appropriate office schedules, applications, shared
 accounts, and communication systems.

-Prepare remote employees for their first working day.

-Verify that required software, communication devices, and remote-access tools are operational.

-Remove or disable access promptly during employee offboarding.

-Maintain documentation of account creation, permissions, and deactivation.

-Coordinate account access requests with HR and authorized management.



7. Business Software and Office Technology

-Troubleshoot software issues involving patient financing platforms such as CareCredit, Cherry, and Sunbit.

-Assist with payment terminal connectivity and configuration issues.

-Provide technical support for online patient forms and electronic documentation.

-Support Google Workspace applications and
 distribution lists.

-Assist with security camera access, door access applications, and approved monitoring systems.

-Troubleshoot basic office technology such as Sonos, television connections, and audio equipment.

-Coordinate with the relevant vendor whenever an application requires specialized support.



8. IT Support Ticket Management

-Monitor the company's IT Support Task Tracker throughout the working day.

-Categorize tickets based on priority, office impact, and urgency.

-Respond promptly to incoming requests.

-Investigate problems using remote troubleshooting software and approved administrative tools.

-Document the issue, actions taken, resolution, and any necessary follow-up.

-Communicate ticket updates to the requesting employee and management.

-Escalate unresolved issues to vendors, senior technical personnel, or onsite support.

-Identify recurring technical problems and recommend preventative actions.

-Maintain accurate ticket statuses and avoid closing unresolved issues without documentation.



9. IT Security and Preventative Maintenance

-Follow HIPAA privacy and security requirements when handling systems containing patient information.

-Apply least-privilege access principles.

-Assist with account security, multifactor authentication, and password resets.

-Support approved remote-access platforms, including ScreenConnect.

-Assist with backup monitoring and restoration coordination.

-Identify outdated software, unsupported operating systems, and potential security risks.

-Coordinate approved software and operating-system updates.

I-mmediately escalate suspected security i
 or unauthorized access.



Required Qualifications

-At least 2 years of professional IT Help Desk, Desktop Support, or Remote Technical Support experience.

-Strong troubleshooting skills with Windows 10/11 and business computer systems.

-Experience with remote desktop access and technical assistance tools.

-Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, Wi-Fi, and VPN connectivity.

-Experience installing and configuring printers, scanners, peripherals, and software drivers.

-Familiarity with user-account administration and access management.

-Ability to diagnose issues independently and communicate solutions clearly.

-Experience using ticket management systems and documenting technical resolutions.

-Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

-Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.

-Ability to prioritize urgent issues affecting multiple offices.

-Reliable internet connection and a secure remote workspace.

-Availability during U.S. Eastern Time working hours.

-Previous IT experience supporting dental or healthcare organizations.

-Knowledge of Denticon practice management software.

-Experience with DEXIS, iTero, or other dental imaging systems.

-Familiarity with VoIP systems, browser-based softphones, and Plivo.

-Experience with Google Workspace administration.

-Familiarity with UniFi, ScreenConnect, and Backblaze.

-Knowledge of HIPAA and healthcare technology security practices.

-CompTIA A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent technical certifications.



Performance Expectations

The selected candidate will be evaluated on:

Timely responses to IT requests according to ticket priority.

Independent resolution of common technical issues.

Accurate and complete ticket documentation.

Effective support for dental software and office communications.

Prompt escalation of issues requiring additional expertise.

Successful setup and removal of employee system access.

Reduction of recurring technical problems.

Professional communication with employees, managers, and vendors.

Reliability, accountability, and consistent follow-through.



Ideal Candidate

Our ideal candidate combines hands-on IT troubleshooting experience with a customer-service mindset.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of technical problems, investigates the root cause, follows up until issues are resolved, and helps prevent future disruptions.

The person in this role must be comfortable supporting multiple office locations simultaneously and understand that fast, accurate technical support is essential to maintaining efficient dental operations.

title: Credit Dispute Specialist
description:
Zhon Credit Is Hiring: Experienced Credit Dispute Specialist



Pay: $125 per week, plus performance bonuses for completing more than 15 client files in a week. Additional files must meet our accuracy, documentation, and completion standards to qualify.



Schedule: Monday through Friday, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. Central Time



We are looking for an experienced, motivated, and detail oriented individual who can manage client disputes from start to finish, work independently, and complete assignments without constant reminders.



Templates and company procedures are provided. You must know how to customize each template to the client’s specific situation and supporting documents.



Responsibilities



• Review all three credit reports and identify inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, or unverifiable information.



• Complete authorized opt-out requests through all websites provided and document completion.



• Prepare individualized letters addressing incorrect personal information, old addresses, and disputed negative accounts, using accurate dates and supporting documents.



• Submit disputes to the appropriate credit bureaus and creditors, including uploading documents to Experian when needed.



• Prepare and submit authorized CFPB complaints when appropriate and submission requirements are met. Address each bureau individually and avoid duplicate complaints.

• Track submissions, responses, deadlines, results, and next steps.



• Keep client records organized and confidential.



• Provide daily updates showing completed work, pending tasks, and scheduled follow-ups.



Productivity and Bonuses



The weekly quota is 15 fully processed client files, averaging approximately 3 per day. A processed file means every step currently due is completed and documented, with future actions scheduled.



Completing more than 15 qualifying client files per week makes you eligible for additional bonuses. Bonus amounts and terms will be explained before work begins.



Accuracy and thoroughness are required. Incomplete files will not count toward the quota or bonuses. Existing client follow-ups must also remain current.



Requirements



• Previous experience handling credit disputes.



• Working knowledge of the FCRA, relevant FTC guidance, and CFPB complaint procedures.



• Ability to customize provided templates and prepare clear, accurate disputes.



• Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management.

title: Proactive Virtual Assistant for coaching and consulting brand
description:
I'm the founder of Flourish with Dr Lolu, and I'm looking for a reliable, detail-minded virtual assistant to keep the business running smoothly while I focus on my clients. This is an ongoing role of about 5 to 10 hours a week, with potential to grow as we build a strong working relationship.



About Flourish

Flourish with Dr Lolu offers doctor-led, one-to-one lifestyle coaching for midlife women in the UK and Nigeria, looking after health in spirit, soul, mind and body. It is run by Dr Lolu Ogunniyi, a practising UK GP and lifestyle medicine physician. The brand is warm, credible and faith-grounded, and most clients find us through WhatsApp, a weekly newsletter and personal recommendation





Role

Virtual Assistant, Flourish with Dr Lolu

Hours

About 5 to 10 hours a week, with potential to grow

Working days

You must be available Thursday, Friday and Saturday, which are my working days for the business. That includes at least 8:00am to 12 noon UK time on each of those days for real-time messages and calls.

Rate

$5.00 USD an hour

Probation

90 days, starting with a 2-week paid trial

The rest of your hours can be arranged around your own schedule, as long as every deadline below is met.

What you will do

Every week:

Load the weekly newsletter into Mailchimp from my draft in Google Drive, send me a test, and schedule it once I approve

Ready for my approval by Saturday

Schedule my LinkedIn post from my draft

Design a WhatsApp Status card for each newsletter in Canva, from my wording

Add captions to my short videos, then post them to Instagram, and repurpose newsletter content for Instagram



End-of-day update on each working day: what you did, any problems, what you need from me, what's next



Project work (as it comes up)

• Website (Squarespace): page edits, fixes, new pages, and a refresh of the look and feel to a brief.

• Client materials in Canva: a welcome pack, a session summary template, a closing review, a branded intake questionnaire and a Christmas gift voucher, all from my wording.

• Simple admin: booking pages, payment links, keeping shared folders tidy, and light research.

• Landing pages and funnels: building landing pages in Squarespace for offers, events and free resources, and connecting them to Mailchimp sign-up forms, tags and automated
 sequences that lead to a booking. Testing every step yourself before it goes live.

What matters most in this role

I write detailed briefs so that you can work independently. The person I'm looking for reads every brief fully and follows it exactly.

1. Read the whole brief before you start, and follow the details: names, dates, links and wording. If something is unclear, ask, with all your questions in one message.

2. Check your own work before you send it. Read it against the brief once more. I should be approving work, not correcting it.

3. Nothing goes public without my sign-off. That includes newsletters, posts, website changes and anything a client might see. Send me a test or a preview first, every time.

4. Be reliable. Meet the deadlines you agree to. If you can't, tell me before the deadline, not after it.

5. Don't disappear. If you're stuck, unsure or behind, tell me. I'd always rather hear "I'm stuck" than nothing.

6. Keep everything confidential. You will see business accounts and some client details. None of it leaves this working relationship. You won't have access to client health conversations, and you must never contact clients, offer places or change bookings unless I've asked you to.

You're a great fit if you

• Have hands-on experience with Mailchimp, Canva and Squarespace, and with scheduling content on Instagram and LinkedIn. Show me examples.

• Are comfortable with Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Calendar). Experience with Stripe payment links or adding captions to short videos is a plus.

• Write in a warm, professional voice in UK English, and can follow a house style exactly.

• Are organised and dependable, and communicate clearly without being chased.

• Notice things: you flag a broken link, a wrong date or a better way of doing something before I spot it.

• Have supported a coach, consultant, health professional or personal brand. This is a plus, not essential.

• Have built a landing page and an
 funnel before (sign-up form, tagging, automated sequence), and can show me one.

To apply

Please include:

1. A brief intro: who you are, and why this role suits you.

2. Your experience with Mailchimp, Canva, Squarespace, Instagram and LinkedIn specifically.

3. One or two examples of work you've done for a client: an
, a post, a design or a web page.

4. Confirmation that you're available on Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays, including 8:00am to 12 noon UK time.

Please start your application with the words "Flourish on Thursdays", so I know you've read this far.

If you're the kind of person who flags things before I notice them, we'll get along well. I look forward to hearing from you.

The short version

We need someone who uses AI to reach the right people in every market and turns that reach into real action on our platforms: agents listing their properties and getting viewings booked, agencies coming on board. Think AI-driven
, AI calling, and social outreach that gets people to like and share, country by country, in the local language. Important: we build and own our systems. We are not looking for someone who rents a pile of subscriptions, we want someone who builds the engine with us so we own it and reuse it. On top of that, you can pick up the broader marketing work too: content, social, basic SEO, paid, analytics.



Who we are

We run several live rental and property platforms in the European market on one shared codebase, plus a new SaaS for the staffing and recruitment sector. We move fast, we test thoroughly, and we reward people who prove results.



How we work (important)

- We build and own our tools. We prefer building over renting. Less vendor lock-in, more control, and everything we build we reuse across our platforms.

- That means working at the level of APIs, your own scripts, and your own automations, not clicking together a stack of expensive closed services.

- You build it once, we own it, and it keeps paying off across every channel and every country.



What you will do (the core)

- Build AI-powered, multi-channel outreach that we own and that scales worldwide, market by market:
 at volume, AI calling, social, and WhatsApp where it fits.

- For the property platform: reach real estate agents in every market and bring them onto the platform, listing their properties and getting viewings booked. The AI calls and messages carry one clear call to action: visit the site and get started.

title: Technical QA Engineer (Laravel + Vue 2, post-deploy), EU property-tech + SaaS, remote
description:
Role

We ship small changes to our live platforms often. We want a technical QA engineer with a real developer background: you think like a user, but you can also read the code path, review merge requests, and tell us when the fix or the AI-suggested change should be different. After each release you check that landlords, renters, candidates and companies can still get from A to B to C. You are not the person who builds features full time, but you are close to a half-developer on our stack. Speed and quality, not one at the cost of the other.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We run several live rental and property platforms on one shared Laravel and Vue 2 codebase, plus a recruitment SaaS where candidates record video intakes for companies and agencies. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



Where you sit in our flow

We roll out to production often and we want to keep that pace. Developers deploy; you are not a gate before release and you do not own the deploy button. After each production rollout you test on
 the journeys that release touched, then the critical paths users depend on, on desktop and mobile, with test accounts and safe paths where we need them. You are the second check after go-live, not a blocker in front of it. When something fails for a real user, you report it fast with steps, expected versus actual, and enough detail that a developer can fix it the same day.



How we work

Our developers work with AI coding assistants and keep their changes small. You test the outcome in the browser and you sanity-check the change in GitLab: read the diff, spot risky patterns, and push back when generated code is sloppy or the wrong layer was touched. If something works on paper but feels wrong in the browser, you say so. You may use AI tools yourself, but the pass or fail comes from what you verified, not from what the model claimed.



What you will do

- After each production rollout, smoke-test the journeys that release touched, on desktop and on mobile

- Re-run the critical journeys per product: listing a property, booking a viewing, uploading documents, recording a video intake, reviewing candidates

- Explore beyond the release note when something looks fragile

- Check that a change on one platform did not break or leak into another platform on the same codebase

- Write clear bug reports: steps to reproduce, expected versus actual, severity, environment, browser and device, screenshot or short video

- Point developers to the file, layer, or request: Blade, Vue component, controller, query, or API response

- Give UX feedback in plain words, for example "a landlord would not know what to do here"

- Review merge requests and recent commits: what changed, what could regress, what should have been tested, what you would do differently

- Suggest concrete improvements to developers (and to AI-generated patches): safer query, clearer validation, better error handling, smaller scope



Requirements

- Strong technical background: you have worked as a developer or as QA embedded with developers, and you can read Laravel and Vue 2 code in a real codebase, not only tutorials

- Hands-on experience with Laravel web applications and Vue 2 front ends in production, or equivalent depth with a similar PHP plus SPA stack and a clear plan to work in our Vue 2 patterns

- Experience with multi-brand or multi-tenant products: one codebase, several sites or customers, and you know how a fix on one brand can break another

- Proven QA on live web products, with examples where your report or your review caught something others missed

- You think in user journeys and in the people behind them

- Clear written English, short and precise

- Solid GitLab or GitHub habits: branches, merge requests, reading diffs, commenting on specific lines

- Browser developer tools: console, network tab, status codes; you tie UI symptoms to backend responses

- Comfortable challenging AI-assisted development: you review output like a senior teammate, not like a checklist-only tester

- Reliable and self-directed: you find the next useful check without being told

- This role is QA and review first. We do not hire you primarily to ship features. Occasional tiny fixes are a bonus, not the job description.



Nice to have

- Accessibility basics: keyboard use, contrast, readable forms

- Ideas for light automated checks or regression notes, without making automation the whole role

- Docker-based local setup or Laravel Mix familiarity



Working hours: full time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 Amsterdam time. That is 15:00 to 23:00 in the Philippines in European summer, and 16:00 to 00:00 when Europe switches to winter time. Please state your timezone and the window you can reliably cover each workday.



Paid trial (before full engagement)

A paid trial week of about five working days, full time, at $3 per hour, tracked with TimeProof after signing. We give you test accounts, a short list of recent rollouts to verify the same way you would after go-live, and read-only visibility on merge requests where useful. You test like a real user on desktop and mobile, file bug reports and UX notes, and add technical review comments where you see risk in the change. You may use AI tools, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you report and every review comment.



The deal

Remote, full time, long term. Hours are tracked with TimeProof. Rate: $3 per hour to start, reviewed on quality and impact. This is a long-term role, not a one-off project.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Start your message with ABC.

2) One bug you found in production that others missed: how you reproduced it and how you reported it.

3) How you would test a release right after it goes live, without slowing every release down.

4) One example of UX feedback you gave that changed a flow.

5) A form submits and nothing happens. What do you send the developer?

6) One merge request or diff you reviewed: what you looked at in the code, what you worried about, and what you asked the developer to change.

7) Your timezone and the Amsterdam-time window you can cover.



Keep it short. Selected applicants do a short video intake on our platform before we talk.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work

- You only know QA in theory and cannot give real examples

- You have never read application code or merge request diffs in a real job

- You only write automated tests and do not think about the people using the product

- You want a pure development role with no testing responsibility

- You cannot write clear English

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools
