title: B2B Appointment Setter – VoIP Phone Systems (UK Market, Remote)
description:
Agility Communications is a B2B IT and telecoms provider based in Lancashire, England. We supply VoIP phone systems to UK businesses, and we're hiring an experienced appointment setter to fill our sales team's diary.



THE ROLE

You'll cold call UK businesses and book meetings for our sales team. You call for one thing only: VoIP phone system opportunities of 5 extensions or more. You'll log every call and meeting in Zoho CRM.



WHAT COUNTS AS A QUALIFIED MEETING (all four must be true)

1. It's a VoIP opportunity of 5 or more extensions.

2. It's booked with the decision maker: the owner, MD, or whoever signs off the phone system.

3. The prospect is in the market to buy now, for example out of contract or actively getting quotes.

4. The meeting happens, and our sales team accepts it as genuine.



For every meeting, you log the call date, meeting date, number of extensions and why they're buying now in Zoho.



HOURS

Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 4:30pm UK time.

- 25th October to late March: 4:00pm to 12:30am Philippine time

- UK summer time: 3:00pm to 11:30pm Philippine time



PAY (USD)

- Base: $650 a month

- Qualified meetings 1–10 each month: $25 per meeting held

- Qualified meetings 11 and over: $40 per meeting held

- Closed deals: 2% of the upfront gross profit on deals from your meetings, paid once we receive it



At 15 qualified meetings a month you earn $1,100, and at 20 you earn $1,300, before deal bonuses. There's no cap.



- Month 1 is ramp-up, with no minimum.

- From month 2, the minimum is 8 qualified meetings held a month.

- Paid monthly in arrears via Wise. Cancelled or no-show meetings don't count.

- Final candidates do a paid trial week at base pay before we hire.



MUST HAVE

- At least 2 years of B2B outbound cold calling with appointment setting. Customer service, inbound, B2C or real estate calling doesn't count.

- Your numbers: dials per day, meetings booked per month, and how many of those meetings happened.

- Excellent spoken English, clear and confident. A neutral or American accent is preferred.

- Reliable attendance on UK hours, every working day.



STRONGLY PREFERRED

- Booking meetings for VoIP or phone systems

- IT, telecoms, managed IT or software sales experience

- Experience calling UK businesses

- Zoho CRM



HOME SETUP

- Main internet: fibre or cable, at least 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload, connected to your laptop by cable

- Backup internet: at least 10 Mbps from a separate source (pocket Wi-Fi, 5G or a second provider)

- A UPS that keeps your laptop and router running for at least 2 hours

- A noise-cancelling USB headset and a quiet room



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word TELECOMS. Applications without it, without a video, or without speed test screenshots won't be read.



Include:

1. A short summary of your B2B appointment-setting experience, with your numbers.

2. Speedtest.net screenshots of your main and backup connections, taken this week.

3. A link to a video of up to 3 minutes (Loom or unlisted YouTube). Record it in one take, camera on, no editing, and answer these:

   a. Introduce yourself. Describe your B2B appointment-setting experience: what industry, which job titles you called, how many dials a day and how many meetings you booked a month.

   b. Have you booked meetings for VoIP, phone systems or IT services? What exactly was being sold?

   c. Role-play: you're calling the owner of a 12-person accountancy firm in Manchester to book a 15-minute call about moving onto a new VoIP phone system. They've just picked up. Go.

   d. The prospect says, "We're happy with our current provider." How do you respond?

   e. Turn your camera to show your workspace, headset, and backup internet or UPS.

title: Business Development Associate – SaaS (UK & Ireland Market)
description:
About MindDiary



MindDiary is an early-stage practice management platform built for therapists and counsellors in Ireland and the UK. It helps practitioners manage enquiries, client intake, appointments, notes, payments and between-session engagement in one place.



We are hiring a full-time Business Development Associate to help us find, engage and onboard our first group of customers. You will work directly with the founder and play an important role in developing MindDiary’s sales process.



What you will do



• Research independent therapists, counsellors and small therapy practices in Ireland and the UK

• Identify relevant prospects and build accurate contact lists

• Contact prospects through personalised email, LinkedIn and phone outreach

• Have professional and friendly conversations with potential customers

• Understand how therapists currently manage appointments, intake forms, notes and payments

• Identify suitable prospects and schedule product demonstrations with the founder

• Follow up consistently with prospects and demo attendees

• Help convert interested therapists into early customers or design partners

• Assist new customers during their initial onboarding

• Keep contact information, conversations and lead statuses updated in the CRM

• Collect customer feedback and report recurring needs, questions and objections

• Test different outreach approaches and improve them based on results

• Provide a clear weekly report covering outreach, replies, conversations, demos and outcomes



What we are looking for



• Strong spoken and written English

• Confident and professional communication over email, phone and video calls

• Experience in business development, sales, appointment setting, lead generation or customer service

• Comfortable initiating conversations with new prospects and handling rejection professionally

• Able to personalise outreach instead of sending generic mass messages

• Strong research, organisation and follow-up skills

• Dependable, self-motivated and comfortable working independently

• Willing to learn the MindDiary product and understand the needs of therapists

• Available full-time with substantial overlap with Ireland and UK business hours

• Reliable internet connection, working computer and a quiet environment for calls



Nice to have



• Experience selling SaaS or other online services

• Experience working with healthcare, therapy, wellness or professional-services businesses

• Familiarity with CRM systems, LinkedIn prospecting and cold
 tools

• Previous experience working remotely with an international company

• Experience supporting customer onboarding or delivering software demonstrations



Working hours



This is a full-time remote position requiring 40 hours per week. Your schedule must include substantial overlap with Ireland and UK business hours because prospects will be contacted during their working day.



Compensation



• US$500 per month

• Additional performance bonuses based on qualified demonstrations and paying customers

• Long-term opportunity with compensation reviews as MindDiary grows



How success will be measured



• Suitable prospects researched and contacted

• Quality and personalisation of outreach

• Positive responses and qualified conversations

• Product demonstrations scheduled and attended

• Consistency and quality of follow-ups

• Paying customers generated

• Accuracy of CRM records and weekly reporting



How to apply



Please include the following:



1. A short introduction explaining your relevant experience

2. An example of how you previously generated leads, meetings or customers

3. A 60–90 second voice or video introduction

4. A short sample message you would send to an independent therapist in Ireland to introduce MindDiary

5. Your availability in Irish time

6. Confirmation that you are comfortable with the US$500 monthly salary



Please personalise your application and mention MindDiary. Generic applications that do not address the role will not be considered.

title: AI Video Editor — Meta Ads (Codex-First / Claude Code, AI-Fluent)
description:
Who We Are

We’re a fast-moving US health supplement brand focused on direct-response Meta ads. We produce short creatives, test quickly, and iterate on what performs.



The Role

Create short bottom-of-funnel video and image ads. Most videos are around 15–30 seconds; a typical batch contains 5–7 variations.



You bring strong editing instincts—pacing, sound, captions, visual clarity—and use AI to produce and revise faster. We use Codex or Claude Code alongside editing tools and services for footage, images, voice, and assembly. You don’t need to know every tool already, but you must be curious and willing to learn a new workflow quickly.



What You’ll Do

- Study reference ads enough to understand their hook, pacing, visual style, offer, and CTA.

- Turn a brief into short Meta videos: UGC, product-led, talking-head, static-to-video, and animated or cartoon-style ads.

- Use your editing skills and AI tools together to create footage, image ads, voice, captions, and variations.

- Use Codex or Claude Code to speed up production, organize assets, make image-ad variations, and automate parts of the edit with tools such as FFmpeg.

- Catch the details AI often gets wrong: product packaging, hands, unnatural movement, awkward voice cuts, unreadable text, and weak timing.

- Deliver a standard 5–7-video batch the same day when possible, within 24 hours once the brief and assets are ready, then turn revisions around quickly.



You’re a Strong Fit If You

- Have made short-form ads and know how to make a 20-second video feel sharp and persuasive.

- Understand direct response and can explain why a hook, offer, or edit might improve performance.

- Actively use AI in creative work—or can show that you learn new AI workflows fast.

- Can work from a reference without needing every cut dictated to you.

- Follow emerging ad formats, including animated and cartoon ads, and know when they suit a campaign.

- Take ownership of the final result instead of assuming an AI output is correct.



Experience with Codex, Claude Code, Kling, Kie.ai, ElevenLabs, or similar tools is a plus. Strong editing judgment and the ability to learn matter most.



Details

Remote, flexible hours. We care about speed, quality, and responsiveness during active batches. Compensation can be agreed per batch, per video, or hourly based on scope and complexity, with a bonus for winning creative.



How to Apply

Send 3–5 examples of ads or individual shots you created, and tell us what you personally did. Include a short Loom walking through one example: your editing choices, how you used AI, and one problem you spotted and fixed. Tell us which tools you use today and what you’d like to learn next.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
We are looking for a motivated, organized, and customer-focused Sales Development Representative to join our team.



In this role, you'll help businesses find warehouse spaces that fit their needs. You'll speak with prospective clients, understand what they're looking for, research available warehouse options, coordinate property tours, and help move qualified opportunities through the sales process.



This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys talking to people, solving problems, staying organized, and working in a fast-paced environment.



You don't need to be a warehouse or real estate expert to succeed in this role. We're looking for someone who is a quick learner, communicates well, takes initiative, and can confidently manage client requests from inquiry through handoff to the sales team.



What You'll Do



- Connect with prospective clients and learn about their warehouse needs.

- Ask the right questions to understand their preferred location, space requirements, budget, timeline, and other preferences.

- Research available warehouse options and identify properties that may be a good fit.

- Share accurate and relevant property information with clients, including:

Pricing and availability

Square footage and property specifications

Amenities and features

Location and access details

Other information relevant to the client's needs

- Respond to client questions and help them understand their available options.

- Coordinate and schedule warehouse tours with clients and property representatives.

- Communicate with warehouse suppliers and property contacts to confirm availability, pricing, specifications, and other details.

- Follow up with clients and suppliers to keep requests moving forward.

- Keep client and property information accurate and up to date in the CRM.

- Identify qualified and interested prospects and hand them off to the Inside Sales Representative for the next stage of the sales process.

- Work closely with sales and operations teams to ensure a smooth client experience.

- Follow up on open inquiries, pending requests, and scheduled tours.

- Maintain a high level of professionalism and responsiveness in all client interactions.



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is proactive, personable, organized, and comfortable communicating with clients.



You may be a great fit if you have experience in:

- Sales or business development

- Customer service or customer success

- Sales support or lead management

- Appointment setting

- Real estate or property management

- Administrative or operations coordination

- Account coordination

- Inside sales



Work Setup & Compensation:



- Schedule: Follows U.S. business hours as needed.

- Location: Remote in the Philippines

- Rate: Hourly in USD



**Please include a link to your resume and short-introduction video in your message**

• Eagerness to create amazing product videos

• Paid time off and paid holidays

• 13th-month pay

• Annual performance-based salary bonus/increases

• Internal training with exclusive knowledge

• Long-term remote position

• Opportunity to learn a highly valuable creative skill

If you're motivated to create beautiful product videos, have a strong sense of aesthetics, and are looking for a long-term, fulfilling career, we'd love to hear from you.



You do not need to be a full professional yet. What matters most is your motivation, your visual understanding, and your willingness to learn our process and work with Canva every day.



Apply today to become a part of our success story!

title: AI AUTOMATION & AI CLONE ENGINEER SSS and Retirement
description:
AI AUTOMATION & AI CLONE ENGINEER

Full-Time Remote — Philippines



 $1,250–$2,000 USD/Month + Bonuses + Benefits + Technology Allowance



We are looking for **one exceptional AI builder** to join our team full-time and, ideally, stay with us for years.



**This is NOT a virtual assistant position.**



We are looking for someone who lives and breathes AI, automation, agents and emerging technology.



If you're constantly experimenting with new AI tools, building automations, figuring out how to make AI do work that normally requires people, and learning what's coming next — we want to talk to you.



## WE ARE LOOKING FOR A LONG-TERM TEAM MEMBER



This isn't a 3-month project.



We have **plenty of work today and a growing pipeline of AI projects for the future.**



We want to find someone exceptional, invest in them, give them great technology to work with, and build a relationship that can last **years and years.**



As our capabilities and client base grow, we want this person's responsibilities, skills and compensation to grow with us.



## YOUR FIRST MAJOR PROJECT: BUILD A COMPLETE AI CLONE



Your first major project will be helping us build a **complete, production-ready AI clone of our founder.**



Not simply a short AI-generated video.



We want a reusable system capable of generating convincing videos using his:



**Voice

Face and appearance

Speech

Lip synchronization

Natural movement

Presentation style**



Once built, we should be able to provide a newscript and generate professional AI videos without repeatedly recording the real person.



This isn't just an experiment.



We already have **5–6 clients ready for AI cloning**, and we expect this service to grow.



Your job will be to help us perfect the process and then make it repeatable for clients.



## AI CLONING IS ONLY PART OF THE JOB



We're building an AI automation company.



You'll also help create:



**AI agents

AI workflows

Business-process automations

24/7 AI workers

CRM automations

Lead-generation systems

Sales and marketing automations

Client onboarding systems

API integrations

Voice AI

AI video systems

Internal business automations**



We want someone who can look at a business problem and ask:



### "How can AI automate this?"



And then actually build it.



## TECHNOLOGY & EXPERIENCE



You don't need to know every tool below.



You DO need to be highly capable with several of them and able to learn new technology extremely quickly.



Experience with:



**OpenAI / OpenAI API

Claude / Anthropic

Gemini

OpenClaw

Hermes or comparable agent frameworks

n8n

Make

Zapier

APIs and webhooks

JSON

Python and/or JavaScript

AI agents

LLM workflows

Voice AI and voice cloning

AI avatars and video cloning

CRM automation**



Experience with ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Synthesia, Tavus, Captions or similar technologies is valuable.



**We care much more about what you've actually built than your degree or certificates.**



## COMPENSATION



### $1,250–$2,000 USD PER MONTH



Starting compensation will depend on demonstrated skill, experience and the quality of your work.



This is a **full-time, long-term position.**



In addition to base compensation, there are opportunities for **performance and project bonuses** as we successfully deploy systems for clients.



Exceptional people who create exceptional value will have opportunities to increase their compensation and responsibilities.



## BENEFITS & LONG-TERM INVESTMENT



We want someone who sees this as a **career opportunity**, not another short-term online job.



After successfully completing the probationary period, eligible team members will receive company-supported Philippine benefits, including:



**PhilHealth health coverage/contributions**



**SSS retirement/social-security contributions**



Additional benefit details, eligibility and company/employee contribution arrangements will be explained during the hiring process and structured in accordance with the applicable employment arrangement and Philippine requirements.



### UP TO $2,000 USD HIGH-PERFORMANCE LAPTOP



We also believe AI professionals need serious equipment.



After successfully completing your **first year with the company**, we will provide or fund an **ultra-high-performance laptop valued at up to $2,000 USD** for eligible full-time employees.



And this isn't intended to be a one-time benefit.



For employees who remain with the company and continue performing at a high level, we intend to provide a **technology refresh allowance of up to $2,000 after each subsequent completed year**, subject to company policy and equipment needs.



We want our AI team working with **excellent technology — not fighting outdated computers.**



## STABILITY



One of the biggest things we can offer the right person is **work.**



We aren't hiring because we have one project that needs to be completed.



We already have AI projects underway, clients waiting, automations to build, cloning projects to complete and considerably more coming.



### We have enough work to keep the right person busy for years.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us as AI changes — and potentially become one of the key technical people in our company.



## PAID FINALIST CHALLENGE



We don't want to hire someone simply because they interview well.



**We want to see what you can actually build.**



Selected finalists will be offered a:



### $75 USD PAID AI CLONING CHALLENGE



We will provide approved source video and audio of our founder.



Your assignment will be to create a **usable AI video + voice clone system** within the agreed scope.



We're not looking for a 15-second trick or filter.



We're evaluating whether you understand how to create a **repeatable AI cloning system capable of producing new content.**



You choose the technology.



Be prepared to explain:



**What tools you selected and why

How the system works

What it costs to operate

Approximate cost per finished minute

How you would automate it

How you would improve quality

How you would reproduce the system for our clients**



Any third-party costs required for the challenge must be disclosed and approved before starting.



## HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with:



### "I BUILD AI."



Then answer:



**1. Show us the 3 most impressive AI automations or agents you've personally built.**



**2. Have you created a realistic AI video or voice clone? Show us examples you are permitted to share.**



**3. What have you actually built using OpenClaw, Hermes or comparable autonomous-agent technology?**



**4. What's the most complicated n8n, Make, API or automation workflow you've built?**



**5. If we gave you high-quality video and audio of someone, what technology stack would you investigate first to create a reusable video + voice clone, and why?**



**6. How would you minimize the ongoing cost of producing videos once the clone is built?**



**7. What's something involving AI you taught yourself in the last 90 days?**



**8. What monthly salary are you seeking in USD?**



**9. Are you available full-time and looking for a long-term position?**



Finally, put:



### DOMINATE



at the very end of your application.



You are welcome to use AI to help prepare your application.



**We're an AI company. We'd be surprised if you didn't.**



But don't let AI invent your experience.



If you say you built something, be prepared to **show it, explain it and demonstrate it.**



We're not looking for someone to complete a project and disappear.



### We're looking for someone we can invest in, keep busy, develop and work with for years.



If you're an AI builder looking for that kind of opportunity, **we want to hear from you.**

description:
BLUEFLOWER TRAVEL COMPANY

Blueflower is a global travel design company crafting intelligent, highly personalized journeys. We design meaningful travel experiences with structure, precision, and care. Our team works remotely across countries and time zones, united by a commitment to excellence and elegant execution. Visit us at www.blueflower.la



We're hiring a Project Manager to join the team.

You don't need a travel background. Most of our team didn't have one when they started; they learned it with us. What we can't really teach is how someone works, and that's what we're hiring for: people who are careful, organized, reliable, and who take real pride in getting the small details right. title: Residential Mortgage Broker
description:
Position Overview



We are looking for a client-focused, driven Part-Time Mortgage Broker to assist our Australian residential clients in securing home loans and refinance solutions. In this role, you will manage client relationships from initial consultation through to loan settlement, structure suitable lending solutions across our lender panel.



Key Responsibilities



1. Client Consultation & Fact-Finding

Conduct comprehensive client discovery calls and meetings to assess financial situations, credit requirements, and property goals. Collect, review, and verify supporting to establish serviceability and borrowing capacity.



2. Deal Structuring & Application Management

Analyze client profiles against lender policy guidelines across our panel to identify appropriate home loan options. Prepare, submit, and track loan applications through broker software from pre-approval through to unconditional approval and settlement.



3. Lender Liaison & Status Tracking

Actively liaise with lenders, credit assessors, and BDMs to follow up on outstanding application statuses, resolve conditions, and expedite turnaround times. Keep clients regularly updated on their loan progress from submission through to settlement.



4. Compliance & Relationship Management

Maintain strict adherence to relevant Australian credit regulations, responsible lending standards, and internal compliance policies. Build and maintain strong ongoing relationships with clients, referral partners, real estate agents, conveyancers, and lender networks.



Qualifications & Requirements



Experience: 2+ years of experience in Australian residential mortgage broking and/or asset finance.

Software Proficiency: Hands-on experience with aggregator software and lodging portals.

Skills & Competencies:

- Strong knowledge of Australian credit policies, servicing calculators, and deal structuring.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills for client and lender interactions.

- High attention to detail with strong organizational and time-management skills in a remote work setting.





If this role matches your skill set, apply now by attaching your resume and
 subject "Residential Mortgage Broker".

title: Daily short-form video creator — ON CAMERA, fluent English (trading education)
description:
I run a
 channel where I share the trades I take in forex and gold, and explain the reasoning behind them. I am looking for ONE person to make and publish one short video per day.



READ THIS FIRST — it saves us both time:



You appear on camera yourself. This is not an AI video job. No AI avatars, no AI-generated UGC, no faceless voiceover over stock footage. If that is what you do, this is not the right job for you.



WHAT YOU WOULD DO

- One short video per day, 30-60 seconds, you on camera

- Topics and scripts come from me: what a stop-loss is, how leverage works, why gold moves on interest rate decisions, how to read an economic calendar, what a pip is

- Write the caption, publish it, keep an eye on the comments

- Roughly 20-25 videos per month



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU

- Fluent spoken English that an international audience follows easily

- Comfortable on camera, speaking to the lens

- You understand trading, or you are genuinely willing to learn it properly. You do not need to be a trader. You need to explain one concept clearly in 45 seconds.

- Your own phone, decent light, a quiet room. No studio needed.

- Reliable: one video per working day, not five in one burst and then nothing



WHAT I WILL NEVER ASK YOU TO SAY

- That results are guaranteed or risk-free, or that anyone will make money

- Any win rate, profit figure or income claim

- Anything you do not understand yourself



This is not a formality. Content like that gets accounts removed, and it is not how this brand works.



WHAT I OFFER

- Fixed monthly rate, paid on time, long term

- Scripts and topics from me; you make them yours

- One brand, one face, built up over months — not scattered one-off gigs



HOW TO APPLY — please read



Do not send a CV or a portfolio of unrelated work. Instead:



1. Record a 30-second video of YOURSELF explaining what a stop-loss is, as if telling a friend who has never traded. Phone camera is fine.

2. Tell me in one or two lines why you want this specific job.

3. Tell me your monthly rate for about 25 videos a month.



Applications without the video will not be read.

title: Notion Expert
description:
About us

Manly makes natural personal care products, including shampoo, conditioner, body wash and deodorant, and sells direct-to-consumer. Our creative team produces a high volume of content: UGC, paid ads, product photography,
 and social. That work is currently spread across scattered docs, DMs and spreadsheets. We need someone to bring it all into one place.



The role

You’ll design and build our creative operations workspace in Notion. It should make it obvious what’s being made, who owns it, where it stands and how it performed. You’ll map how our team works today, design a better workflow, build it, and train the team to use it. The goal is a system people want to use, not one they have to put up with.



What you’ll build



Creative request and briefing system: intake forms, brief templates, and a clear path from idea to approved brief

Production pipeline: a content calendar and Kanban boards that track every asset from brief through draft, review, approved and live

UGC and creator hub: a creator CRM covering outreach status, rates, usage rights, deliverables, payments and content links

Asset library: a searchable database of finished creative, tagged by product, scent, format, channel, hook and creator

Performance tracking: a way to log ad results (CTR, CPA, ROAS) against each asset, so winning concepts are easy to find and iterate on

SOPs and wiki: documented processes for briefing, review, approvals and file naming

Dashboards: views for the team lead, creators, editors and paid media, each showing only what that person needs



Must have



Deep Notion expertise: relational databases, rollups, formulas, templates, linked views, automations and permissions. Please show us systems you’ve built.

Experience setting up workflows for creative, marketing or content teams

The ability to turn messy, informal processes into simple, structured systems

Strong documentation and training skills, so the team can maintain what you build without you

Good judgment on when to stop adding features and keep things simple



Nice to have



Ecommerce or DTC brand experience

Notion integrations and automation tools such as Zapier, Make, Slack, Google Drive and 

A background in project management, creative production or agency operations

Notion certification or published templates



How to apply

To be considered, fill out this Google Form: 

Applications that don’t come through the form won’t be reviewed. Please include links or Loom walkthroughs of Notion systems you’ve built, ideally for creative or marketing teams.

title: Accountant | 6-Month Contract
description:
About Us



Mad Mex is back to its OG roots! Fighting for Flavour, Defending for Freshness, and always bringing a Por El Sabor (for the flavour) attitude to everything we do.



We’re not here to play it safe or serve bland, boring “Mexican”. We’re here to bring big, bold, unapologetically Mexican flavours to Australia and build the most loved Mexican brand in the country while we do it.



With over 75 restaurants and growing fast, we’re entering our next phase of growth, investing in our brand, story, culture and familia, and bigger, bolder ways to bring Por El Sabor to life.



About the Role



We’re looking for an Accountant to join us on a 6-month contract, with the potential to become permanent for the right person. You’ll own our Payroll and Bank Reconciliation processes and keep the numbers behind every restaurant accurate and on time. You’ll also back up the wider Finance team and help shape how we use AI and automation to work smarter.





What You’ll Be Doing



Payroll



- Own the end-to-end payroll process, from timesheet validation and pay runs through to releasing pay and lodging STP.

- Pay super and PAYG, and prepare, lodge and pay payroll tax in line with statutory and company deadlines.

- Deliver the weekly labour report on time and reconcile payroll balance sheet accounts.

- Manage the payroll inbox and respond to internal and ad hoc payroll queries.

- Liaise with our Workers Compensation insurer on annual lodgements and declarations across states and entities.

- Drive continuous improvement in payroll processes.



Bank & Revenue Reconciliations



- Complete daily bank reconciliations, investigating unmatched deposits and missing bankings with Business Managers.

- Reconcile petty cash weekly, confirm till floats by store monthly, and reconcile credit cards monthly back to the GL.

- Reconcile cash receipts, EFTPOS and Windcave online order receipts, and assist with delivery reconciliations when required.



Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Reporting



- Support AP, including booking invoices in NetSuite, validating the weekly AP export from TASK, reconciling supplier statements, and processing AP and rent payments.

- Support AR, including raising royalty, marketing fee and ad hoc invoices, processing direct debits and following up the AR ageing.

- Manage the shared Accounts inbox daily and support cash flow reporting.

- Own assigned period end tasks and monthly balance sheet reconciliations, and support audits with accurate, timely reports.

- Deliver ad hoc projects and special reports that give the business sharper insights.



AI, Automation & System Transformation



- Support our Finance AI automation project by documenting current processes and identifying manual pain points and automation opportunities.

- Act as a finance subject matter expert, translating accounting and compliance requirements into clear business rules for the project team and technology partners.

- Assist with solution design, UAT, data validation and parallel runs to make sure automated outputs are accurate and compliant.

- Help maintain controls, approvals, audit trails and exception handling in automated workflows.

- Support data quality and master data clean-up across NetSuite, payroll and related systems.

- Update procedures, prepare training materials and help the Finance team adopt new tools and processes.





What You Bring



- 3+ years’ accounting experience, including end-to-end payroll and bank reconciliations (hospitality preferred).

- Qualifications in accounting, business or commerce.

- Sound knowledge of Australian payroll requirements, including STP, superannuation, PAYG, payroll tax and workers compensation.

- Experience with ERP and payroll systems; Oracle NetSuite, Tanda and KeyPay preferred.

-Broad exposure across AP, AR, bank and revenue reconciliations, period end and balance sheet reconciliations.

-A strong interest in AI and automation within finance, with the ability to document processes and support testing and adoption of new tools. System transformation experience is preferred.

- Intermediate to advanced Excel skills (macros, XLOOKUPs); Power Query preferred.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving and attention-to-detail skills.

- Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong organisation and time management, with the ability to meet deadlines under pressure and work independently or in a team.

- A stable internet connection for remote work.

- Most importantly, you’re curious, adaptable and ready to Own It.



Why Mad Mex?



You’ll join a fast-growing Familia where Finance directly supports our restaurants, our people and our franchise partners.



There’s plenty of opportunity to learn, innovate, improve and grow into new areas of the department.



Bring your numbers game. Bring your curiosity for automation. Bring the Por El Sabor.





Please include a link to your CV and your monthly salary expectations with your application. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We can’t wait to see the spice you’ll bring to the table!

We are an authorized reseller of Mitchell 1 software for independent auto repair shops in the United States. Short demo videos:

After the sale you will help new customers get started, train their service writers and technicians on the basics, and handle first-line software questions. You will work closely with a small team, share what is working, and keep our CRM up to date.



Demos are a big part of this job. You will learn our products quickly from Mitchell 1's sales materials and product videos, then turn them into short, crisp pitches and screen-share demos built around what a shop owner cares about: saving time, making money and getting cars out the door.

- Experience running live product demos (screen share or in person), and reviewing sales materials to build your own short, clear pitch.

- Experience cold calling US businesses, with daily call volumes you can describe.

- Clear, confident spoken English suited to busy US small-business owners.

title: Record Yourself Playing Videogames
description:
Hi! I’m looking for someone who really loves gaming, can record smooth, high quality 4K gameplay and is okay with talking while playing - just basic comments of what is happening - camera or showing yourself on the gameplays is not needed



Three times a week you’d record one 2 to 3 hour gameplay session in 4K. The playing should be slow and relaxed, like exploring, building or just wandering around, with no fast action and no shouting. Every now and then you say a little comment about what you’re thinking or what you see. 



Nothing planned and no script, just small natural thoughts with quiet moments in between. Your voice should be a bit softer and slower than normal. There’s no intro or outro and no face camera, you just start playing. You’d send me each recording within 3 days.



The recording quality must be very high. That means 4K at 60 fps, smooth, with no lag, stutter or dropped frames. You can play on a gaming PC or a console, as long as your setup can record like this. You’ll also need a headset or mic with clear sound and no background noise, and stable internet to upload the large files. 



The pay is $120 per month for 12 videos. This is a long-term job, and in the future we’ll need more gameplays



I’m looking for someone patient, relaxed and reliable. Respecting deadlines is a must.

title: HR & Bookkeeping Specialist
description:
QUALIFICATIONS — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



QuickBooks certification is mandatory. Please do not apply if you are not QuickBooks certified. Include proof of your certification with your application.



You must also have:



• At least 3 years of relevant experience in HR, people operations, or workforce administration, with practical bookkeeping experience.

• Hands-on experience with recruitment, onboarding, contractor agreements, timekeeping review, performance documentation, and offboarding.

• The ability to create and improve SOPs, organize workflows, and follow through until issues are resolved.

• Practical knowledge of financial recordkeeping, transaction categorization, invoicing, account reconciliation, and billing review.

• Strong spreadsheet, reporting, and written and spoken English skills.

• Sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to work independently and prioritize during urgent situations.

• Availability to work 40 hours per week, starting at 6:00 a.m. U.S. Eastern Time.



Experience with BPO operations, remote contractor teams, financial controls, or rental-property bookkeeping is strongly preferred. Accounting experience is an advantage.



ABOUT THE ROLE



Geospatial Solutions LLC is a U.S.-based services company with a distributed contractor team and multiple business activities.



We are looking for a proactive specialist who can build and maintain reliable HR and bookkeeping processes. Our priority is a stable operation that continues functioning when workloads change, contractors leave, or unexpected problems arise.



You should be comfortable identifying gaps, proposing solutions, implementing approved improvements, and following through without repeated reminders.



You will organize financial records across company activities and the owner’s personal finances, including rental and Airbnb finances. Some records will be prepared by other stakeholders. You will coordinate their contributions, review completeness and accuracy, and ensure outstanding items are resolved.



An administrative assistant will help create trackers and support reporting. You will review those records and remain responsible for the accuracy and follow-through within your scope.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Build reliable operating processes



• Review existing HR and bookkeeping workflows and identify gaps, recurring errors, and dependencies on individual people.

• Create and maintain practical SOPs, checklists, templates, deadlines, and approval procedures.

• Establish clear responsibilities so everyone knows who prepares, reviews, approves, and follows up.

• Maintain handover procedures, backup arrangements, and escalation steps for critical tasks.

• Address recurring problems at their source and check that improvements are being followed.



2. Recruitment, onboarding, and contractor continuity



• Coordinate frequent recruitment, including job postings, screening, interviews, references, and hiring recommendations.

• Maintain a candidate pipeline for recurring roles and anticipate staffing gaps.

• Organize onboarding, agreements, orientation, and required records.

• Help contractors understand expectations, responsibilities, communication standards, and performance requirements.

• Identify reasons for contractor turnover and recommend practical improvements to retention and continuity.

• Help retain dependable, high-performing contractors and prepare orderly handovers when people leave.



3. HR administration and contractor support



• Prepare and review agreements, amendments, and notices using approved templates.

• Check names, rates, dates, responsibilities, and other details for completeness and consistency.

• Maintain organized, confidential contractor and personnel records.

• Communicate approved policy changes, role updates, and internal announcements.

• Coordinate offboarding and termination documentation and communications after management approval.

• Flag unusual contract terms and sensitive matters for appropriate review.



4. Timekeeping and performance oversight



• Review timesheets, work-tracking records, and administrative reports for missing entries, inconsistencies, and unusual activity.

• Compare reported hours with assignments, completed work, quality, and project-lead feedback.

• Investigate discrepancies fairly, document findings, and follow up until resolved.

• Help management identify strong performers, underperformance, coaching needs, and staffing concerns.

• Track agreed improvement actions and report whether they have been completed.

• Use verified information and work results alongside tracking records when assessing performance.



5. Company bookkeeping and billing



• Maintain organized financial records in QuickBooks and keep supporting documentation accessible.

• Record and categorize transactions, clearly distinguishing business activities and projects.

• Reconcile assigned accounts and coordinate any reconciliations handled by other stakeholders.

• Prepare client invoices using approved hours, rates, and project terms.

• Track receivables, outstanding balances, payment deadlines, and approved collection follow-ups.

• Review contractor payment summaries and supplier bills for accuracy.

• Investigate missing receipts, duplicate charges, billing discrepancies, and unexplained transactions.

• Prepare routine financial summaries and organize records for management and the accountant.

• Follow up with stakeholders until missing information and discrepancies are resolved.



6. Personal, rental, and Airbnb bookkeeping



• Organize records for designated personal accounts, rental properties, and Airbnb activities.

• Coordinate with property managers, administrators, and other stakeholders who prepare financial information.

• Review income, expenses, statements, receipts, and payment records for completeness and consistency.

• Track upcoming obligations and flag overdue items or unusual charges.

• Keep personal, company, and property records clearly separated and appropriately categorized.

• Protect confidential financial information and maintain clear supporting records.



7. Administrative coordination and client-growth support



• Guide the administrative assistant on tracker structure, required information, and reporting deadlines.

• Review trackers and reports before relying on them for decisions.

• Provide secondary support for prospect tracking, proposal information, and follow-up coordination.

• Help coordinate staffing and onboarding when new client work is approved.



HOW WE EXPECT YOU TO WORK



• Own your responsibilities from start to completion.

• Maintain a prioritized task list and meet agreed deadlines without frequent reminders.

• Bring problems to the Chief of Staff with the facts, your recommendation, and the specific decision needed.

• Resolve routine matters independently within agreed procedures and authority.

• During urgent situations, identify what is affected, protect critical deadlines, coordinate available support, and escalate promptly.

• Provide a concise weekly report covering completed work, unresolved issues, staffing needs, financial exceptions, and upcoming deadlines.

• Obtain approval for hiring, termination, pay changes, payments, and other financial commitments.



FIRST 60 DAYS



• Review the existing operation and agree on the most important improvements with the Chief of Staff.

• Establish clear workflows, owners, deadlines, and trackers for essential HR and bookkeeping tasks.

• Put priority SOPs and handover procedures into use.

• Organize financial records and identify outstanding bookkeeping issues, with owners and deadlines for resolution.

• Establish a consistent recruitment, onboarding, timekeeping, and performance-review routine.

• Create practical contingency procedures for sudden contractor departures, missing records, and urgent billing or staffing issues.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



• Essential processes continue functioning when people leave or workloads change.

• Recruitment and onboarding move forward consistently.

• Financial records are organized, accurate, and available when needed.

• Billing and timekeeping discrepancies are identified and resolved promptly.

• Dependable contractors receive clear expectations and consistent support.

• Management spends less time chasing updates and coordinating routine tasks.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. Your resume and proof of QuickBooks certification.

2. A brief summary of your HR and bookkeeping experience, including the size and type of teams you have supported.

3. One example of an operational system or SOP you created and how it improved the business.

4. One example of an urgent staffing, timekeeping, or financial problem you handled, including what you resolved independently and what you escalated.

5. Your experience organizing financial records across multiple business activities, personal accounts, or rental properties.

6. Confirmation of your availability for the stated schedule and your expected monthly compensation within the posted range.

title: Experienced Viral Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Hiring: Experienced Viral Short-Form Video Editor (AI & Humanoid Robotics)



Remote | Philippines | Long-Term Opportunity



Pay: $5 USD per video, plus a performance bonus of $1 per 100K views on each platform



Potential for consistent high-volume work



About Us



We are a fast-growing educational business focused on one of the most exciting technology trends: AI, humanoid robotics, and the investment opportunities around this industry.



We teach people how to understand and invest in the rapidly evolving humanoid robotics market.



We are looking for a creative, experienced short-form video editor who can turn raw robotics footage into scroll-stopping videos for:



 Reels

TikTok

Instagram Reels

YouTube Shorts

Other short-form platforms



Our goal is to publish a high volume of videos that attract attention, spark curiosity, and grow our audience.



What We’re Looking For



We do NOT want someone who simply cuts footage, adds subtitles, and calls it finished.



We want an editor who understands why videos go viral: someone who can capture attention in the first 1-2 seconds, build curiosity and excitement, and keep viewers watching to the end.



You’ll work with footage of humanoid robots, futuristic technology, AI breakthroughs, and robotics companies, and turn it into highly engaging short-form content.



Your Responsibilities



1. Create Powerful Hooks



Grab attention within the first 1-2 seconds.

Use strong opening visuals, headlines, and sound effects.

Make viewers immediately curious about what happens next.

Suggest creative hooks and angles instead of only following instructions.



2. Turn Raw Footage Into Engaging Shorts



Transform raw robotics footage into captivating 15-60 second videos.

Select the most interesting moments and organize them into a compelling story.

Use dynamic cuts, zooms, motion graphics, and visual effects where appropriate.

Add high-quality animated subtitles and on-screen text.

Set a pace that keeps people watching instead of scrolling away.



3. Understand Viral Content



Stay on top of trends and content styles that perform well on TikTok,
, Instagram, and YouTube.

Use curiosity, suspense, storytelling, and pattern interrupts.

Analyze reference videos and recreate the editing principles that make them work.

Suggest improvements to make our videos more engaging.



4. Produce Content Consistently



Edit multiple short-form videos per week.

Deliver on agreed deadlines.

Maintain quality even at high volume.

Create alternative hooks or opening sequences for testing when requested.

Deliver professional vertical 9:16 videos, ready to publish, with no watermarks.

Requirements

Minimum 2 years of relevant video editing experience, or a portfolio showing exceptional skill.

Strong experience creating TikToks, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, or YouTube Shorts.

Excellent understanding of hooks, storytelling, pacing, and viewer retention.

Skilled in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, or similar software.

Experience creating attention-grabbing captions, text animations, and motion graphics.

Good English, including the ability to write strong English-language hooks.

Ability to work independently and bring creative ideas.

Reliable communication and consistent turnaround times.

Strong attention to detail.



Bonus (not required):



Interest in technology, robotics, or investing.

Experience creating viral technology or educational videos.

Experience editing content that generates leads or sales.

Ability to suggest video concepts and opening headlines.

Compensation & Performance Bonus



Base pay: $5 USD per completed original short, based on editing complexity and demonstrated skill. We prefer per-video pay instead of hourly pay.



Performance bonus: For every video you edit, you earn an extra $1 for every 100,000 views on each platform, counted separately per platform.



Example: if one of your videos gets 100K views on YouTube, 100K on Instagram, and 100K on TikTok, that is a $3 bonus on top of your base pay. A video that reaches 300K views on TikTok alone earns a $3 bonus from TikTok.



Views are counted on each platform’s own analytics, 30 days after posting.

Bonuses are paid monthly, together with your base pay.



The bonus rewards videos that perform well, and it grows as we post more and our audience grows. Our goal is a long-term working relationship where we scale content production together.



What We Provide

Raw footage and relevant content materials.

Creative direction and examples of the styles we like.

Clear feedback and content guidelines.

Consistent work for the right editor.

Opportunities to take on more responsibility as we grow.



How to Apply



Please include:



Portfolio: Links to your 3 best short-form videos, ideally showing strong hooks, engaging visuals, and high-quality editing.

Your experience: How long have you been editing short-form videos?

Your rate: What is your price per 30-60 second video?

Your capacity: How many high-quality shorts can you realistically produce per week?

Your process: How do you make the first 2 seconds of a video grab attention?

Your tools: What editing software do you use?



Creative question:



Imagine you receive raw footage of an impressive humanoid robot walking, working, or interacting with people. Give us 2 different opening hook ideas that would make viewers stop scrolling. We want to see how you think.



Paid Test Project



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid test edit using footage we provide. We will evaluate creativity, storytelling, visual quality, pacing, communication, and turnaround time.



To show you’ve read the full job description, start your application with the words “ROBOTICS EDITOR”.



We’re looking for someone exceptional to help us build a large-scale short-form content operation. If you understand attention, storytelling, and viral editing, we’d love to see your work.

**This is a sales-focused role, NOT a general VA position.**



## ABOUT OUR BUSINESS

We have a growing Instagram community of over 218,000 followers.



**Instagram: 
)**

- Monday to Friday

- $4 USD per hour

- Fully remote

- Continue working through our existing outreach lists.

- Build genuine conversations with potential fitness coaching clients.

- Target 50 messages per dedicated outreach hour.

- Respond quickly to active conversations.

- Consistently offer and book qualified sales calls.

- Work towards monthly new-client acquisition goals.

- Maintain accurate lead tracking and reporting.

## THE TYPE OF PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🔥



We're not looking for someone who simply logs in, sends a few messages and waits for their shift to finish.



We're looking for someone who genuinely wants to succeed.



**PLEASE READ CAREFULLY BEFORE APPLYING.**



### 1. FAST REPLIES ARE NON-NEGOTIABLE

### 3. YOU MUST BE HUNGRY FOR RESULTS



We want someone who genuinely enjoys sales, hitting targets, booking calls and improving their performance.



Someone who wants to be the best at what they do.



### 4. TAKE OWNERSHIP



Your shift, your conversations and your responsibilities matter.



If something isn't working, we want someone who identifies the problem, communicates it and suggests a solution.



### 5. BE QUICK BUT ACCURATE



Speed is important, but so is attention to detail.



We expect quality conversations, accurate tracking and minimal missed opportunities.



### 6. BE COACHABLE



We provide scripts, systems, training and feedback.



We need someone who listens, implements feedback quickly and actively wants to improve.



### 7. BE RELIABLE AND CONSISTENT



We need someone we can trust to show up on time, attend daily meetings and perform without constant supervision.



## EXPERIENCE & REQUIREMENTS



- Previous experience in Instagram DM setting or appointment setting.

- Confident sales and communication skills.

- Experience handling objections and qualifying leads.

- Comfortable managing multiple conversations simultaneously.

- Experience with Meta Business Suite and tracking spreadsheets.

- Reliable internet connection and suitable working setup.

- Ability to work independently during UK nighttime hours.

- Consistent, long-term remote work.

- Support from an existing sales team.

- Daily team meetings and ongoing feedback.

- Opportunities to develop and grow within the business.

4. Confirmation that you can work **11pm–6am UK time, Monday to Friday**.

5. Confirmation that you can attend our **3pm Dubai time daily team meeting, Monday to Friday**.

6. A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you'd be a strong addition to our team.



### APPLICATION QUESTIONS — PLEASE ANSWER ALL FOUR



**Question 1:** You're halfway through your shift, the inbox is quiet and nobody is replying. What do you do next?



**Question 2:** You're managing 10 active Instagram conversations at once. How do you prioritise them and make sure nobody is forgotten?



**Question 3:** Tell us about a time you took initiative at work without being asked.



**Question 4:** Take a look at our Instagram page 
 do you think our ideal client is, what are her biggest struggles, and how would you approach starting a genuine conversation with someone interested in our coaching?



**Please give specific answers. Generic or copy-and-paste applications will not be considered.**

If you're looking for an easy job where you can log in, send a few messages and wait for your shift to end, this position is not for you.



If you're a slow texter, struggle with initiative or need constant reminders to complete your work, this position is not for you.

**If you're fast, motivated, reliable and hungry to succeed, we'd love to hear from you!**

title: Static Ad Creator / Performance Creative Strategist
description:
We’re looking for a full-time AI Static Ad Creator / Performance Creative Strategist to create high-quality static ads for
 and Instagram.



This is not a basic graphic design role.



We are looking for someone who understands that good ads start with research, customer psychology, strong messaging, and clear strategy — not just making something look nice.



You will be creating ads for a financial services business serving clients in British Columbia, Canada.



Our services include areas such as:



- Life Insurance

- Business Insurance

- Investment Planning

- TFSA and other investment accounts

- Critical Illness Insurance

- Disability Insurance

- Estate Planning

- Retirement Planning

- Business Owner Financial Strategies



Our goal is to create ads that get attention, explain a financial problem clearly, and generate qualified leads and booked consultations.



What You Will Be Doing



You will be responsible for:



- Researching target customers

- Researching competitors and existing ads

- Understanding customer problems, needs, fears, and goals

- Finding strong advertising angles

- Writing hooks and headlines

- Creating static ads for
 and Instagram

- Using AI tools to create realistic images

- Creating professional financial-services advertisements

- Creating different versions of successful ads

- Reviewing ad performance

- Using performance data to improve future ads

- Testing different headlines, images, layouts, messages, and audiences

- Organizing ads so we know what is being tested

- Following brand guidelines

- Making complicated financial topics easy to understand



We Want Strategy, Not Random Designs



We do not want someone who simply opens Canva and starts designing.



Before creating an ad, you should be thinking about:



- Who are we targeting?

- What problem does this person have?

- What does this person want?

- What are they worried about?

- What do they already know about the product?

- What would make them stop scrolling?

- What message would make them interested?

- What would make them trust the ad?

- What should we test?

- Why should this ad perform better than another ad?



You should be able to explain the reason behind your creative decisions.



Main Audiences



A large part of our advertising will focus on:



- Business owners

- Professionals

- High-income individuals

- Families

- People with money sitting in savings

- People looking for better financial strategies

- People who already have insurance

- People who need investment planning

- People approaching retirement

- People planning how to protect or transfer their wealth



Business owners will be an important part of our marketing.



Types of Ads You May Create



You should be comfortable creating different types of static ads, including:



- Problem and solution ads

- Educational ads

- Comparison ads

- Authority-style ads

- Editorial-style ads

- Native social media ads

- Testimonial-style ads

- Financial education ads

- Product-focused ads

- Lifestyle ads

- Curiosity-based ads

- Simple direct-response ads

- Ads using numbers or financial examples



We want different styles and approaches depending on the audience and message.



Research Is Important



Research will be a major part of the job.



You should be comfortable researching through:



- Meta Ad Library

- Competitor websites

- Competitor landing pages

-
 and Instagram ads

- Reddit

- Forums

- Social media comments

- Customer reviews

- Financial websites

- Existing successful ads

- Customer feedback

- Internal ad performance data



You should be able to take what you learn from research and use it to create better advertising.



Performance Matters



We are not looking for someone who only makes beautiful graphics.



The ads need to perform.



We are looking for someone who understands direct-response advertising and how creative affects:



- Click-through rate

- Cost per lead

- Lead quality

- Booked appointments

- Conversion rate

- Ad spend

- Revenue

- ROAS



Previous experience creating Meta ads that generated strong results is highly preferred.



If possible, please provide screenshots or examples showing the performance of ads you personally worked on.



A strong design portfolio is helpful, but performance experience is more important.



AI & Design Tools



You should be comfortable using modern AI and design tools.



Experience with tools such as:



- ChatGPT

- Midjourney

- Gemini

- Higgsfield

- Sora

- Flux

- Photoshop

- Canva

- Other AI image-generation tools



is valuable.



We do not care which exact tools you use as long as the final work is high quality.



You should be able to create realistic:



- People

- Business owners

- Professionals

- Families

- Offices

- Homes

- Business environments

- Lifestyle scenes

- Financial-related imagery



AI-generated images should look realistic and professional.



They should not immediately look AI-generated.



AI should help you create better ads.



AI should not replace strategy.



British Columbia & Canadian Compliance



All advertisements will be shown to people in British Columbia, Canada.



This means all advertising must follow applicable British Columbia and Canadian financial-services advertising rules and guidelines, as well as any compliance instructions we provide.



Experience advertising in other countries is useful, but you should not assume that a claim allowed in another country is automatically allowed in Canada.



Because we work in financial services, accuracy is extremely important.



You must carefully follow the product information and approved information we provide.



You cannot invent or exaggerate:



- Investment returns

- Expected investment performance

- Guaranteed returns

- Tax savings

- Tax deductions

- Insurance benefits

- Policy features

- Financial results

- Product guarantees

- Product comparisons

- Eligibility

- Pricing

- Rates

- Relationships with financial institutions or insurance companies



Advertisements must not be false, misleading, or create an incorrect impression about a financial product or service.



Important conditions or limitations should not be hidden just to make an ad more attractive.



If you are unsure whether something can be claimed, ask before putting it in the advertisement.



We will provide the necessary product information, approved facts, brand direction, and compliance guidance.



You do not need to be a Canadian financial advisor or compliance expert.



However, you must be willing to follow Canadian and British Columbia advertising requirements carefully.



Your job is to turn accurate information into advertising that is:



- Simple

- Clear

- Professional

- Persuasive

- Easy for normal people to understand



What We’re Looking For



You should have:



- Experience creating Meta static ads

- Direct-response advertising experience

- Strong research skills

- Strong copywriting instincts

- Ability to write hooks and headlines

- Good understanding of customer psychology

- Good understanding of advertising angles

- Excellent visual judgment

- Strong AI image-generation skills

- Ability to create realistic AI images

- Ability to simplify complicated information

- Understanding of creative testing

- Ability to review advertising performance

- Ability to improve winning ads

- Strong attention to detail

- Fast turnaround times

- Good communication

- Ability to follow instructions

- Ability to accept feedback

- Ability to work independently

- Ability to think strategically

- Willingness to carefully follow Canadian and British Columbia compliance requirements



Experience in any of the following is a bonus:



- Financial services

- Insurance

- Investing

- Fintech

- Banking

- Lead generation

- Professional services



Financial-services experience is helpful but not required if you have strong advertising skills.



The Mindset We Want



We want someone who naturally asks:



- Who is this ad for?

- What problem are we solving?

- What does the customer want?

- Why would they care?

- What would make them stop scrolling?

- What message will make them interested?

- What objection might they have?

- How can we make the ad more believable?

- Is the message accurate?

- Can we legally and accurately make this claim?

- What should we test next?

- Why did the previous ad work or fail?

- How can we improve it?



We do not want someone whose first thought is:



“What cool AI image can I make today?”



The strategy comes first.



The design comes second.



Position



Full-Time / Long-Term



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of our marketing team.



We plan to continuously create and test new ads for
 and Instagram.



There is room to grow for someone who consistently produces strong work and helps improve advertising performance.



How To Apply



Your application should include:



- Your portfolio

- Examples of static ads you personally created

- Examples of
 or Instagram ads

- Any performance screenshots you can provide

- One example of an ad you worked on that performed well

- A short explanation of what YOU personally did for that ad

- A short explanation of how you research before creating new ads

- A short explanation of how you d
 what to test next

- The AI and design tools you currently use

- Your availability

- Your expected monthly salary

- Industries you have worked in before

- Any experience with financial services, insurance, investing, lead generation, or high-ticket services



Please do not apply with only a general graphic design portfolio.



We are looking for someone who understands advertising, direct response, customer psychology, and performance.



Shortlisted applicants will be contacted directly.

title: AI Video Editor
description:
AI Video Editor, Short-Form, Faceless AI Content (Long-Term)

AI generation needed



We make faceless short-form videos with AI avatars for a hair-care brand sold on Amazon. They post on TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels and YouTube Shorts. We're hiring several AI video editors long-term. If you're fast, consistent and take direction well, this is steady work.



This is not a cut-only editing job. You generate the video with AI tools and you edit it, start to finish. Every script comes with a reference video that already performed. You build our avatar's version of it.



What you'll do, on every video



1. Watch the reference video and read the script. Where the script doesn't say what goes on screen, work it out from the reference.

2. Reuse the avatar's scene images, or make new ones with AI image tools when the script needs them.

3. Generate the talking clips in Google Flow.

4. Edit the video in CapCut: tight pacing, no dead space, a strong first frame, clean captions and visuals that show what she says.

5. Check it for technical problems: gaps, cut-off words, glitches, captions, sound.

6. Check it against the script and the reference video, side by side.

7. Hand it off on our production sheet and in 
.



Videos run from about 30 seconds to 3 minutes. You apply feedback from one video to every video after it.



Quota and pay



- $300 to $600 a month, depending on quality and output, bonuses included. Training is paid from day one. 

- All trainees start at $300, unless you have exceptional video quality already.

- Once you're trained: five accepted videos per day.

- A video counts only when it passes our quality check. A minor fix still counts. A full remake counts once, when the fixed version is accepted.

- You manage your own time, just make sure deliverables are on time. You can take a day off, but build the videos ahead of time so there's no gap. No skipping a day and catching up after.

- Bonus: $5 for every accepted video above your monthly target, up to $50 a month, plus performance bonuses.

- We pay for the AI generation software.

- Set your own hours. There are no fixed shifts. Deadlines are per video.

- Initial 30-day review.



You're a fit if you



- Have short-form editing experience in CapCut or similar, ideally talking-head videos.

- Have hands-on AI generation experience: Google Flow or Veo 3, Nano Banana, Grok or similar.

- Use AI tools outside of work, try new models, and watch content about AI.

Not for you if

Training



You get a full written onboarding with step-by-step guides and real examples of what gets sent back.
